The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Manager RM & Distribution Analytics to join our Revenue Management Analytics team. In this role, you will partner closely with Global and Regional Revenue Management Leadership teams to advance key analytics and strategic priorities. You will support corporate, regional, and property teams by developing tools, AI capabilities, statistical models, algorithms, insights, and strategies that advance revenue optimization. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines canopen the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care for Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family.Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious100 Best Companies to Work For®list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally

  • Flexible work schedule

  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center

  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption

  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

Responsibilities include partnering with Global and Regional Revenue Management Leadership teams to drive key analytics and strategic priorities. The role supports corporate, regional, and property teams through the development of tools, statistical models, algorithms, AI capabilities, insights, and strategies for revenue optimization.

  • Drive analytics and strategic priorities with Global and Regional Revenue Management Leadership teams.

  • Develop tools, statistical models, algorithms, AI capabilities, insights, and strategies that support revenue optimization.

  • Partner with corporate, regional, and property Revenue Management teams.

  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels of the organization as a trusted business partner.

Experience Required

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Strategic agility.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with all levels of the organization.

Computer Skills Needed to Perform this Job

  • Working knowledge of Python or R for data analysis, modeling, and automation.
  • Proficiency with AI-enabled analytics tools, including generative AI, to support analysis, automation, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Advanced SQL programming skills and extensive experience working with relational databases.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and VBA.

Additional Comments and Requirements

  • Experience developing analytical models and visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools is preferred.
  • Experience with Alteryx is preferred.
  • Experience with GitLab or comparable Git-based version-control platforms, with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) preferred.
  • Ability and willingness to work effectively in a fast-paced, complex corporate environment.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

The salary range for this position is $130,000-$150,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work.Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

Job description:

We are a growing, multi-location dental group looking for an experienced, hands-on Digital Marketing & Paid Ads Specialist to manage our PPC campaigns, improve lead generation, and drive new patient acquisition.

We need someone who can personally build, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns. This is a performance-focused position, not a general social media management role.

We value qualified leads that convert into scheduled and attended consultations, not simply high lead volume.

Our ideal candidate is proactive, results-driven, and comfortable taking ownership of advertising performance, identifying problems, and implementing solutions.

Dental experience is a plus, but preferred.

Priority will be given to candidates with GoHighLevel (GHL) and experience in lead generation within dentistry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, manage, and optimize PPC campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram).
  • Manage advertising budgets, keyword research, targeting, bidding strategies, and A/B testing.
  • Track campaign performance, cost per lead, conversion rates, and return on advertising spend.
  • Build and troubleshoot GoHighLevel pipelines, workflows, automations, and lead routing.
  • Configure and monitor conversion tracking, lead attribution, and KPI reporting using GA4, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics tools.
  • Improve landing pages, lead quality, and appointment conversions.
  • Collaborate with our internal marketing and operations teams to improve campaign performance and patient acquisition.

Qualifications

  • Proven, hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns is required.
  • Strong understanding of PPC, paid search, SEM, keyword research, and conversion optimization.
  • Experience managing advertising budgets and analyzing campaign performance.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and CRM/marketing automation platforms.
  • GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Dental or healthcare marketing experience is helpful but not required.

Schedule

This is a full-time, 35-40 a week position. We prefer local candidates who can complete initial training in person, with the opportunity to transition into a hybrid or remote role based on performance.

Qualified remote candidates will also be considered if the technical requirements can be met and can collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

To Apply

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to:

  • Complete a paid practical assessment.
  • Provide examples of Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns you personally managed, including advertising budgets and measurable results.
  • Provide examples of improvements you've made to lead generation or campaign performance.
  • Details of your GoHighLevel experience, if applicable.
  • Professional references who can verify your experience and results.

Benefits:

  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • PTO
  • Holiday Pay
Salary: $50,000 – $70,000 / year

Over de functie

Als Functioneel Analist en Systeemexpert analyseer en documenteer je de functionele behoeften van eindgebruikers. Jobinhoud

  • Je analyseert de functionele behoeften van key users uit de verschillende businessunits.

Je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring in functionele analyse en hebt ervaring als Senior Functional Analyst.

Functie-eisen

  • Je beschikt over kennis van actuele analysemethodes en -tools.
  • Je hebt ervaring met functionele analyse op basis van gesprekken met eindgebruikers, met als doel hun functionele behoeften duidelijk in kaart te brengen.
  • Je hebt ervaring met samenwerking binnen kleine en middelgrote ontwikkelteams.
  • Je hebt kennis van het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van datagegevens.
  • Een achtergrond in development is een pluspunt.
  • Kennis van ERP is een pluspunt.
  • Je kent API-concepten zoals REST, JSON, XML, OAuth en webservices.
  • Je hebt ervaring met tools zoals Postman en Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Je hebt kennis van DDD, agile ontwikkelingsmethodes, BPMN, UML en testmethodologieën.
  • Je kent standaardbedrijfsprocessen binnen administratie, productie en logistiek.
  • Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma in een ICT-georiënteerde richting.

Talenkennis

  • Nederlands: actieve kennis, mondeling en schriftelijk.
  • Frans: basiskennis, mondeling en schriftelijk.
  • Engels: gevorderde kennis, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Gedragscompetenties

  • Je communiceert vlot en kunt bevindingen en analyses helder mondeling en schriftelijk overbrengen.
  • Je streeft naar kwaliteit en een klantgerichte dienstverlening.
  • Je werkt goed samen met een team van toepassingsbeheerders en Product Owners.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en gestructureerd, met oog voor detail, en kunt vlot op afstand werken.
  • Je hanteert een pragmatische aanpak, bent stressbestendig en draagt de waarden veiligheid, betrouwbaarheid, verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerking hoog in het vaandel.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

raw.description:
Our Company

PharMerica

Overview

** This is a remote role**

The Implementation Consultant is responsible for independently leading and managing new customer implementations, change of ownership initiatives, pharmacy and facility moves, and other complex customer transition projects. This role serves as a consultative partner to customers and internal stakeholders, assessing business and operational needs, developing implementation strategies, identifying risks, recommending solutions, and guiding projects through successful completion.

The Implementation Consultant exercises discretion and independent judgment in evaluating customer requirements, interpreting operational needs, establishing project priorities, resolving complex implementation issues, and recommending appropriate courses of action. The position works collaboratively across multiple functional areas to ensure implementation solutions align with customer expectations, operational capabilities, service standards, and business objectives.

The successful candidate is highly organized, forward-thinking, analytical, and an effective communicator who takes a proactive and consultative approach to problem solving. This individual must be comfortable independently leading multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while adapting strategies based on changing customer and operational needs.

Benefits and perks for You!   

  • Medical, Dental, Vision insurance   
  • Health Savings & Flexible Spending Accounts (up to $5,000 for childcare)   
  • Tuition discounts & reimbursement   
  • 401(k)
  • Company Paid Time Off*
  • Shift Differential
  • DailyPay
  • Pet Insurance
  • Employee wellness and discount programs

*Benefits may vary by employment status  

Responsibilities

  • Serves as the primary implementation consultant and subject matter resource for assigned new customer implementations, change of ownership projects, pharmacy moves, facility relocations, and other customer transition initiatives
  • Independently leads assigned implementation projects from initial planning through execution, stabilization, and post-implementation review
  • Consults with customers and internal stakeholders to assess business needs, operational requirements, service expectations, implementation readiness, and potential risks
  • Exercises discretion and independent judgment to evaluate project requirements and determine appropriate implementation strategies, priorities, timelines, and recommended courses of action
  • Develops comprehensive implementation plans, project timelines, milestones, agendas, and deliverables based on customer requirements and organizational objectives
  • Evaluates customer needs and recommend appropriate products, services, processes, or operational solutions to support a successful transition
  • Provides consultative guidance to customers regarding implementation requirements, operational considerations, dependencies, timelines, and recommended practices
  • Determines the appropriate involvement of internal service areas, including Customer Field Service, IV, Clinical Consulting, Clinical HUB, pharmacy operations, and other functional partners based on the individual needs of each implementation
  • Leads internal and external project meetings, facilitate discussions, provide recommendations, communicate decisions, assign action items, and ensure appropriate follow-up
  • Analyzes complex or changing project circumstances and independently identify solutions or recommendations based on available information, customer requirements, business needs, and operational considerations
  • Proactively identifies project risks, implementation barriers, service gaps, and competing priorities and develop mitigation strategies to minimize disruption to customers and operations
  • Uses advanced knowledge of pharmacy operations, service standards, and implementation practices to anticipate challenges and determine appropriate solutions
  • Provides guidance and recommendations to internal stakeholders regarding customer requirements and the operational impact of implementation decisions
  • Investigates implementation and quality concerns, determine root causes, recommend corrective actions, and escalate significant business or customer issues when appropriate
  • Evaluates changes in project scope, business requirements, timelines, or operational circumstances and determine necessary modifications to implementation plans
  • Conducts pre-implementation assessments to evaluate customer and operational readiness and identify opportunities requiring additional planning or intervention
  • Conducts post-implementation assessments to evaluate results, identify trends or service gaps, and recommend actions to improve customer outcomes and future implementations
  • Analyzes customer feedback, implementation outcomes, operational experience, and project data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement
  • Recommends improvements to implementation processes, workflows, tools, documentation, and customer transition practices
  • Develops and communicates implementation metrics, project status, risks, outcomes, and recommendations to customers, business partners, and leadership
  • Creates and maintains customer-specific implementation documentation in accordance with department and organizational standards
  • Ensures project documentation, decisions, action items, deliverables, and customer requirements are accurately maintained within designated systems and SharePoint
  • Independently manages multiple concurrent implementation projects and establish priorities based on customer impact, operational risk, project complexity, timelines, and organizational objectives
  • Builds collaborative relationships with customers and cross-functional business partners and influence outcomes without direct supervisory authority
  • Serves as a resource to internal partners regarding implementation processes, customer transition requirements, and recommended practices
  • Participates in special projects and initiatives intended to improve customer implementation processes and overall service delivery
  • Performs other related duties as assigned
  • Conducts job responsibilities in accordance with the Company's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, policies and procedures, Corporate Compliance Agreement, applicable federal and state laws, and applicable professional standards

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years of progressively responsible experience in customer implementation, project management, project coordination, healthcare operations, pharmacy operations, customer relationship management, or a related field required
  • Experience independently managing customer implementations, projects, operational initiatives, or complex cross-functional activities required
  • Demonstrated experience assessing business or operational needs and recommending solutions required
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, independently evaluate information, identify risks, and determine appropriate courses of action required
  • Experience managing multiple projects or priorities with competing deadlines required
  • Experience within pharmacy, healthcare, or customer implementation operations preferred
  • Experience in a Long-Term Care Pharmacy environment preferred
  • Experience consulting with customers regarding operational processes, services, or business solutions desired
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional customer implementations desired
  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent required
  • Combination of education, training, and progressively responsible professional experience sufficient to successfully perform the responsibilities of the position required
  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Project Management, Pharmacy/Healthcare Services, or a related discipline preferred
  • Project management certification or formal project management training preferred
  • Pharmacy Technician certification or registration, where applicable desired
  • Strong consultative and customer relationship management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion and independent judgment
  • Ability to assess customer business and operational needs and recommend appropriate solutions
  • Strong project leadership and project management skills
  • Ability to independently analyze complex situations and determine appropriate courses of action
  • Strong critical-thinking, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities
  • Ability to anticipate project risks and develop effective mitigation strategies
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong presentation, consultation, and meeting facilitation capabilities
  • Ability to communicate recommendations effectively to customers, leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Ability to influence decisions and outcomes without direct authority
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills
  • Strong planning, prioritization, and organizational abilities
  • Ability to independently manage multiple complex projects with competing priorities and deadlines
  • Ability to adapt strategies and recommendations based on changing customer and business requirements
  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining a broader understanding of customer and organizational objectives
  • Ability to interpret project metrics and use information to identify trends and opportunities for improvement
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office and relevant project management and collaboration technology
  • Experience using metrics and performance indicators to evaluate project outcomes
  • Working knowledge of pharmacy operations, standards, and customer service requirements, as applicable
  • Ability to work effectively and independently within a remote work environment

About our Line of Business

PharMerica, an affiliate of BrightSpring Health Services, delivers personalized pharmacy care through dedicated local teams, serving health care providers such as skilled nursing facilities, senior living communities, and hospitals. We also cater to individuals with behavioral needs, infusion therapy needs, seniors receiving in-home care, and patients with cancer. Operating long-term care, home infusion, and specialty pharmacies across the nation, we combine the personal touch of a neighborhood pharmacy with the resources of a national network. Our comprehensive solutions, backed by industry-leading technology and regulatory expertise, ensure accurate medication access, cost control, and compliance with best-in-class clinical standards. We are committed to enhancing resident health, reducing staff burdens, and supporting our clients' success. For more information, visit www.pharmerica.com. Follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn.

raw.title: NIS2 IT System Engineer voor Asset Management en Platformsecurity (Freelance mog
raw.excerpt: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden De Europese NIS2-richtlijn (Network and Information Security Directive 2) heeft als doel de cyberweerbaarheid van vitale en essentiële organisaties binnen de EU aanzienlijk te verhogen.
raw.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

De Europese NIS2-richtlijn (Network and Information Security Directive 2) heeft als doel de cyberweerbaarheid van vitale en essentiële organisaties binnen de EU aanzienlijk te verhogen. De richtlijn verplicht lidstaten en organisaties om technische en organisatorische maatregelen te nemen die de continuïteit en veiligheid van essentiële diensten en digitale infrastructuren waarborgen.

De verplichtingen hebben onder meer betrekking op:

  • Beleid en governance: duidelijke verantwoordelijkheden, toezicht en rapportering over cyberweerbaarheid.
  • Risicobeheer: een structurele aanpak van risico’s op het gebied van informatie- en netwerkbeveiliging.
  • Beveiligingsmaatregelen: technische en organisatorische controls volgens de stand van de techniek.
  • Incidentbeheer en meldplicht: detectie, rapportering en opvolging van beveiligingsincidenten.
  • Leveranciersbeheer: beheersing van risico’s in de keten en toelevering.
  • Continuïteit en herstel: weerbaarheid tegen verstoringen, met inbegrip van business continuity en disaster recovery.

Binnen de betrokken overheidsorganisatie loopt een meerfasig programma om de organisatie structureel volgens de NIS2-vereisten in te richten. Naast technische maatregelen vraagt dit programma ook organisatorische inbedding, governance, risicobewustzijn en change management. De projecten zijn gebaseerd op het CyFun-framework van het CCB.

In de realisatiefase worden de geïdentificeerde maatregelen geïmplementeerd in projecten per CyFun-functie. Voor twee prioritaire projecten is extra ondersteuning nodig:

  • NIS2 Asset Management, CyFun-functie IDENTIFY [ID.AM]. De focus ligt op de identificatie en het beheer van systemen, mensen, assets, data en processen als basis voor risicogebaseerde cybersecuritybeslissingen.
  • NIS2 Data & Platform Security, CyFun-functies PROTECT [PR.DS en PR.PS]. De focus ligt op de bescherming van data en platformen via gegevensbeveiliging, veilige configuratie, softwarebeheer en technische beveiligingsmaatregelen.

2. Opdracht

Als IT System Engineer ondersteun je de uitvoering van de projecten NIS2 Asset Management en NIS2 Data & Platform Security. Je werkt samen met interne teams en externe leveranciers, met bijzondere aandacht voor de inventarisatie van besturingssystemen en software.

1.1 Hoofdtaken en verwachte deliverables: Asset Management (CyFun ID.AM)

De CMDB en inventarissen uitbouwen en actualiseren

Je vergelijkt inventarisgegevens over besturingssystemen en software uit verschillende bronnen met de gegevens in de CMDB. Je spoort ontbrekende, dubbele en verouderde gegevens op, verifieert afwijkingen met de betrokken teams en vult CMDB-records aan of corrigeert ze. Samen met de interne teams werk je het CMDB-gegevensmodel bij waar nodig.

Verwachte deliverables: een bijgewerkte CMDB en actuele inventarissen van besturingssystemen en software, aangevuld met een overzicht van gecorrigeerde en nog openstaande afwijkingen en een bijgewerkt gegevensmodel.

Bestaande documentatie van operationele processen aanvullen en actualiseren

Je toetst de bestaande procesbeschrijvingen voor assetbeheer aan de praktijk. Ontbrekende informatie vul je aan en verouderde onderdelen werk je bij. Je legt vast wie de CMDB en inventarissen onderhoudt, wanneer dit gebeurt en hoe de volledigheid en juistheid worden gecontroleerd.

Verwachte deliverables: geactualiseerde procesbeschrijvingen met duidelijke verantwoordelijkheden voor het beheer en onderhoud van de CMDB en inventarissen.

De uitwisseling van assetgegevens met externe leveranciers technisch ondersteunen

Je stemt met externe leveranciers af welke gegevens beschikbaar en nodig zijn. Je vraagt gegevens op en maakt afspraken over het formaat en de frequentie van aanlevering. Samen met de interne teams controleer en verwerk je de ontvangen gegevens in de CMDB en inventarissen.

Verwachte deliverables: gevalideerde en verwerkte leveranciersgegevens en gedocumenteerde afspraken over de aanlevering en actualisatie ervan.

1.2 Hoofdtaken en verwachte deliverables: Data & Platform Security (CyFun PR.DS en PR.PS)

De huidige situatie documenteren en analyseren en technische maatregelen uitwerken en mee implementeren

Je documenteert en analyseert eerst de huidige situatie (AS-IS). Je actualiseert de inventarissen van gegevens, systemen en platformen en beschrijft de bestaande beveiligingsmaatregelen en operationele processen. Vervolgens stel je samen met de betrokken teams de technische tekortkomingen ten opzichte van de toepasselijke NIS2-vereisten vast, beschrijf je de gewenste situatie (TO-BE) en werk je een technisch implementatievoorstel uit. Je werkt mee aan de implementatie en technische validatie van de afgesproken maatregelen.

Verwachte deliverables: een AS-IS-analyse met bijgewerkte inventarissen en procesbeschrijvingen, een overzicht van de technische tekortkomingen, een beschrijving van de gewenste situatie, een technisch implementatievoorstel en documentatie van de uitgevoerde maatregelen en testresultaten.

3. Samenwerking & positionering

De NIS2 IT System Engineer werkt nauw samen met verschillende verantwoordelijken en teams:

  • Programmaverantwoordelijke NIS2: rapportering, prioritering en afstemming binnen het programma.
  • Businessverantwoordelijke of NIS2-expert: rechtstreekse ondersteuning en inhoudelijke sturing van de projecten.
  • Verantwoordelijke voor de serverinfrastructuur: technische afstemming, prioritering en coördinatie van werkzaamheden op de serverinfrastructuur.
  • Securityverantwoordelijken: technische input en validatie van maatregelen.

4. Vereiste kennis & ervaring (verplicht)

  • Bachelor- of masterdiploma in informatica, bedrijfskunde, bestuurskunde, of gelijkwaardig door relevante ervaring.
  • Minimaal 6 jaar ervaring met asset management-tools of CMDB-concepten.
  • Praktische ervaring met het modelleren, beheren en valideren van inventarisgegevens voor besturingssystemen en software.
  • Ervaring met het aanvullen en actualiseren van operationele procesdocumentatie en SOP’s voor IT-assetbeheer. Je kunt technische processen en werkinstructies helder beschrijven.
  • Ervaring met technische afstemming en gegevensuitwisseling met externe leveranciers.
  • Ervaring met het documenteren van controles en het verzamelen van bewijsstukken voor audits.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, analytisch, nauwkeurig, samenwerkingsgericht, pragmatisch en oplossingsgericht.

Technische kennis

Linux, PHP, SQL en Windows zijn voor deze functie vereiste kennis op expertniveau.

  • Windows
  • Red Hat en Oracle Linux
  • Windows Application Server en Apache
  • Oracle DB, SQL Server en PostgreSQL
  • .NET, PHP, PowerShell en Linux-scripting

Troeven

  • Ervaring binnen een federale overheidsdienst of een vergelijkbare publieke organisatie.
  • Ervaring met NIS2-implementatietrajecten of eerdere betrokkenheid bij cybersecurityprogramma’s.
  • Kennis van het CyFun-framework en/of gerelateerde frameworks zoals ISO 27001, NIST CSF en CIS Controls.
  • Kennis van AD en GPO.

📝 Jouw profiel

Je hebt ervaring als IT System Engineer en combineert minstens 6 jaar ervaring met asset management of CMDB-concepten met een expert niveau in Linux, PHP, SQL en Windows. Je werkt zelfstandig en nauwkeurig, kunt technische processen helder documenteren en stemt vlot af met interne teams en externe leveranciers.

Je spreekt en schrijft Nederlands en Frans.

  • Linux
  • PHP
  • SQL
  • Windows

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

(Freelance is ook mogelijk)

raw.description:
About the Role

We're hiring a Market Associate to support the hotel partnerships team at a global travel marketplace. You'll manage a high volume of hotel partners and take each one from signed agreement to live and bookable on the platform. This is an operations and onboarding role, not a sales role. You'll take handoffs from several Account Executives, keep a busy pipeline moving through each stage, and hand launched properties to Market Managers. The role suits someone organized and detail-oriented who does well with repeatable, process-driven work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a pipeline of hotel partners and move each one from handover to live and bookable on the platform.
  • Triage internal hotel queues and support connectivity setup. Work with hotels and their connectivity partners to resolve issues and confirm that rates, inventory and availability flow correctly.
  • Review listing details (room types, photos, rates, availability) to confirm each property is guest-ready, then set it live.
  • Guide hotels through required identity and business verification (KYC), then hand properties off to Market Managers.
  • Take work in from several Account Executives and coordinate handoffs to several Market Managers.
  • Contact hotel partners by phone, email and Zoom to collect business details and move assigned projects forward.
  • Keep detailed, well-organized tracking for every property and project.
  • Track progress against weekly and quarterly go-live targets, and prioritize the properties closest to launch.
  • Teach partners how the platform works, and build strong, lasting partner relationships.
  • Act as a responsive "front desk" for hotel partners: triage their requests and give timely, high-quality service.
  • Find ways to manage and streamline workflows.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in account management, partner support or partner onboarding.
  • Very strong attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational skills, including keeping a large pipeline of work moving across several stages.
  • Comfortable with repeatable, process-driven work at high volume.
  • Strong time management and prioritization, and the ability to adapt as priorities and deadlines change.
  • Excellent communication skills across phone, email and Zoom.
  • Strong people skills, including working with several internal teams whose roles overlap.
  • A self-starter who gets things done, uses initiative and works independently with little hand-holding.
  • Driven by goals, and comfortable with a high volume of calls and meetings.

Preferred

  • 2+ years of experience in the hospitality or travel industry.
  • Experience onboarding partners onto an online marketplace or platform. Examples include online travel agencies, property management systems, booking engines, and channel or connectivity providers. Onboarding experience from other marketplaces, such as car rental or mobility platforms, also transfers well.
  • Experience working with hotel connectivity (rates, inventory, availability).
  • Based in the Mid-Atlantic or Northeast.

Key Details

  • Start date: December 8, 2026
  • Duration: About 12 months (through December 3, 2027), with possible extension
  • Location: Remote, home-office based. Candidates must live in the U.S. east of the Mississippi River. No travel required.
  • Work schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week, 5 days/week
  • Pay rate range: $45.00-$53.00/hour + benefits
  • Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
  • Engagement: W-2 Contract
Salary: $45 – $53 / hour

Turn health data into clearer reporting and smarter workflows for North Carolina.

Mfinite Consulting is hiring a Junior Data Scientist for a contract assignment with the North Carolina Health Information Exchange Authority (NC HIEA), part of the NC Department of Information Technology (NCDIT). NC HIEA operates NC HealthConnex, the state-designated health information exchange that supports secure electronic sharing of health data across North Carolina. You'll support operational, analytical and quality improvement work: cleaning and validating data, monitoring automated workflows, building dashboards, and finding ways to replace manual effort with repeatable, scalable processes.

Schedule

  • Full-time, about 40 hours per week
  • 100% remote, with all work performed in the U.S.
  • Contract from January 1, 2027 through June 30, 2027
  • W-2 hourly employee of Mfinite Consulting LLC

What You'll Do

  • Clean, validate, transform and summarize operational and healthcare data
  • Merge complex files and prepare structured datasets for reporting and analysis
  • Monitor automated workflows and troubleshoot data pipeline issues
  • Build and maintain dashboards for executive and operations reporting, and support KPI initiatives
  • Support recurring monthly reporting cycles and integrated reporting processes
  • Identify ways to streamline manual processes and reduce repetitive tasks through automation
  • Document processes and write standard operating procedures (SOPs)
  • Track reporting requirements and improvement initiatives in project tools such as Jira and Asana

What You Need

  • 3+ years cleaning data, merging files and preparing structured datasets
  • 3+ years supporting recurring reporting tasks or monthly data cycles
  • 2+ years developing dashboards in Power BI and/or Tableau
  • 2+ years translating and interpreting technical data for executive reporting
  • Bachelor's degree in health informatics, statistics, data science, public health, information systems or a related field
  • Strong Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, data validation and merging complex datasets
  • Basic SQL for simple querying, filtering and data extraction
  • Familiarity with Salesforce for pulling reports, reviewing data fields or supporting operational workflows
  • Familiarity with Smartsheet and basic familiarity with Jira and Asana
  • Experience documenting processes or workflows in SOPs
  • Experience supporting workflow automation, process standardization or continuous improvement
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a curious, proactive approach to fixing inefficiencies
  • Legally authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Able to complete a webcam (video) interview

Great Fit If You Have

  • Familiarity with health information exchange operations and interoperability concepts
  • Knowledge of IHE ITI transaction codes/profiles and related interoperability performance metrics
  • Experience with operational or healthcare data from academic projects, internships or professional roles

How to Apply
Apply directly through this posting. Please make clear on your résumé how many years you have in each area under "What You Need." Qualified applicants will be contacted for a short screening call. Reference checks are part of our process. We are unable to sponsor visas.

About Mfinite Consulting
Mfinite Consulting LLC is a veteran- and woman-owned company headquartered in Columbia, MD, with a team in Raleigh, NC. We place dependable, fully screened professionals with public-sector clients. Positive Outcomes. Proven Results.

Mfinite Consulting LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Questions? Email .

We do not accept Corp-to-Corp (C2C) arrangements. We work directly with candidates only. Unsolicited submissions will not be considered, and no placement fees will be paid. Candidates are encouraged to apply directly.

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

Junior Full Stack Engineer (Independent Contractor)

Location | Latin America — Remote
Engagement Type | Independent contractor (services agreement)
Availability | General overlap with U.S. Eastern Time

About LoanBud

LoanBud is a fast-growing fintech platform dedicated to SBA financing, connecting entrepreneurs to a nationwide network of lenders and helping small business owners access capital through a streamlined, technology-driven process. We pride ourselves on a collaborative culture, meaningful work, and a strong commitment to supporting the backbone of the economy — small businesses.

Engagement Overview

LoanBud is seeking a junior independent contractor to help build, maintain, and support our proprietary lending and workflow platform. The platform is used by borrowers, loan officers, processors, underwriters, referral partners, lenders, and internal teams.

This is a hands-on engagement for an early-career engineer who wants to grow inside a real production application. You will work mainly in our Java and Spring Boot backend, with contributions to TypeScript front-end work, database changes, and integrations, under the guidance of senior engineers.

Great communication is central to this role. Alongside engineering work, you will support platform users by phone — walking borrowers, loan officers, and partners through issues, gathering clear details about problems, and explaining solutions in plain, friendly language. We are looking for someone who enjoys helping people as much as writing code.

Scope of Services

With support and code review from senior engineers, the contractor will help with:

  • User support by phone — take calls from borrowers, loan officers, processors and partners; troubleshoot their issues live; document what you learn; and follow up until the issue is resolved.
  • Backend — implement and maintain APIs, business logic and integrations in Java 21 / Spring Boot; learn to update underwriting and business rules in Drools.
  • Front end — build and improve TypeScript front-end features and fix UI bugs.
  • Data — write PostgreSQL queries and simple migrations (Spring Data JPA, Liquibase).
  • Integrations — help connect internal and external services via REST APIs and webhooks; keep OpenAPI specs up to date.
  • Async & workflow — monitor background jobs and scheduled processes (JobRunR) and help investigate failed jobs.
  • Platform features — contribute to document storage (S3), email and PDF generation, and SMS (Twilio) features.
  • Reliability — investigate and fix bugs reported by users, turning support calls into clear, reproducible tickets.
  • Delivery — write clean, tested, documented code; take part in code reviews and releases; and share progress, questions and blockers early.

Required Experience
  • 1–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent through internships, bootcamps or substantial personal projects.
  • Excellent communication skills, including confidence supporting users over the phone — patient, clear and friendly with non-technical people, and able to explain technical issues in simple terms.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Working knowledge of Java (Spring Boot exposure is a plus).
  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
  • Some experience with TypeScript or JavaScript front-end development.
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs and how authentication works.
  • Comfort with Git and an interest in automated testing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Eagerness to learn, accept feedback, and grow within an existing codebase.
  • Reliability and accountability: you follow through on what you commit to and keep your team informed.

Nice to Have
  • Previous experience in customer support, help desk, technical support or any client-facing role.
  • Spring Boot 3, Spring Data JPA, Liquibase or Lombok.
  • Exposure to background job frameworks (JobRunR or similar) or rules engines (Drools or similar).
  • AWS basics (S3), Docker or CI/CD pipelines.
  • Twilio, PDF generation or email templating (Thymeleaf).
  • Interest in fintech, lending or regulated industries.
  • Spanish or Portuguese in addition to English.
  • A GitHub profile or portfolio showing projects you've built.

Working Arrangement

This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement. The contractor sets their own schedule, methods and location, and provides their own equipment, workspace, reliable internet and a quiet setting suitable for phone calls with users.

The contractor should generally be reachable during a window overlapping U.S. Eastern Time business hours. This is when users call for support and when planning, code reviews and team discussions happen; it is not a mandated schedule or minimum-hours requirement.

Engagement Terms

This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. The contractor is responsible for their own taxes, social contributions, insurance and any registrations required in their jurisdiction, and is not entitled to employee benefits.

Service fees will be based on experience, technical ability and communication skills. Fee structure, invoicing, engagement term and other commercial terms will be discussed during the selection process. The contractor is free to provide services to other clients; exclusivity is not required.

Selection Process

Interested providers should submit a current résumé, along with any work samples or links (GitHub, portfolio) where available.

  1. Initial HR conversation, including an assessment of spoken English and communication style.
  2. Short practical technical exercise.
  3. Support role-play: a simulated phone call with a user reporting a platform issue.
  4. Conversation with our technical leadership.
  5. Final conversation on culture, scope and terms.

We'll share details on each step as you move through the process.

Be Part of Our Growth Story

LoanBud is building a better way for entrepreneurs to access capital, and technology is central to that effort. This engagement is a chance to grow your engineering career on a real fintech platform while directly helping the people who use it — borrowers, partners and lenders.

We're looking for someone who communicates clearly, cares about users, and is eager to learn and follow through. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs to gain access to capital.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced and highly organised HR & Recruitment Specialist to oversee recruitment, onboarding and day-to-day HR operations.

The ideal candidate will have strong people-management skills, excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage employee processes while ensuring that documentation, credentials and compliance requirements are kept up to date.

This role is suited to someone who can work independently, communicate confidently and help build efficient HR processes as the organisation grows.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment process, including job postings, application reviews, candidate screening and interviews.
  • Coordinate hiring needs with management to ensure staffing requirements are met.
  • Oversee employee onboarding, including paperwork, background checks, credential verification and compliance.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and personnel files.
  • Track employee licenses, certifications, credentials and renewal deadlines.
  • Coordinate staff training and monitor mandatory training requirements.
  • Manage day-to-day HR queries, employee documentation and administrative tasks.
  • Support management with performance concerns, attendance issues and employee accountability.
  • Develop and improve HR processes as the organisation grows.
  • Help ensure compliance with employment regulations and healthcare staffing requirements.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience in HR, recruitment, HR operations or a related field.
  • Previous supervisory or HR leadership experience.
  • Experience managing recruitment, onboarding and employee documentation.
  • Familiarity with background checks, credentialing, compliance and training requirements.
  • Experience in healthcare, behavioural health or a service-based organisation is highly preferred.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
  • Comfortable handling confidential and sensitive employee matters.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, applicant tracking systems (ATS) and HR management software.

Ideal Candidate

We’re looking for someone who is smart, proactive, highly detail-oriented and confident when dealing with people. The successful candidate should be able to take ownership of HR processes, communicate professionally, maintain confidentiality and hold employees accountable.

Healthcare or behavioural health HR experience will be a strong advantage.

raw.description:
About Sharesource:

We are a BCorp company whose purpose is to democratise opportunities for individuals from developing countries. With our brand and culture empowering our partners to attract and keep the most qualified members, we share the knowledge to unleash potential and grow scaling teams for Australian and Canadian businesses.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Junior Civil Drafting Engineer to support the production of post-design packages, including right-of-way permit and construction packages, using AutoCAD and AI-assisted tools. Working under the guidance of the Civil Works Manager and senior drafting staff, you will collaborate closely with the Permitting, Project Management, and Design teams to prepare accurate, compliant drawings that capture project specifications such as roads, utilities, and other civil works.

This is a development role ideal for an early-career drafter looking to build strong technical skills in the telecommunications infrastructure industry.

What are you expected to do?

  • Drafting
    • Complete assigned AutoCAD drafting tasks for active civil projects in line with project priorities and deadlines.
    • Manage your own workload, communicate progress on assigned tasks, and raise any risks to deadlines early.
    • Learn and apply client's AutoCAD standards, tools, and best practices, building towards independent production work.
    • Prepare drawings and plan sets from redlines, markups, and design inputs under the direction of senior team members.
    • Interpret survey data and engineering specifications into construction drawings, with guidance and review from senior team members.
    • Update and revise drawings and permit packages in response to agency, client, or internal review comments.
    • Raise drafting and design questions with project managers, engineers, and the Civil Works Manager to clarify scope.
  • Quality and Standards Compliance
    • Apply internal CAD templates, standards, and best practices to all deliverables, following guidance provided by the Civil Works Manager.
    • Check drawings against applicable safety standards, environmental codes, and jurisdictional permitting requirements, with final compliance review by senior team members.
    • Self-review work for accuracy and completeness before submitting for QC, flagging any discrepancies or uncertainties to senior team members.
    • Incorporate redlines and QC feedback promptly, using them to build your knowledge of standards and drafting practices.
  • Technical Analysis and Design Support
    • Assist with reviewing survey data, site conditions, and regulatory constraints to support accurate and compliant drawings.
    • Calculate material quantities and perform basic calculations to support construction package accuracy, with work checked by senior team members.
    • Build a working knowledge of local regulations, jurisdictional requirements, and industry drafting practices relevant to telecom and civil projects.
  • Travel
    • Travel occasionally to project sites or client locations as required, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 5–10% of working time.


You'll be a great fit if:

  • You have working proficiency in AutoCAD and an interest in AI-assisted drafting tools. You have an eagerness to learn and adopt new technologies, which is essential in our fast-moving environment.
  • You have strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality, with the ability to produce accurate, consistent, and thoroughly checked deliverables.
  • You have good organisational and time management skills, with the ability to work across several assignments at once, prioritise with support from your manager, and meet agreed deadlines.
  • You have a collaborative mindset and clear communication skills. You can interact regularly with the Civil Works Manager, Project Managers, and network designers, and have the confidence to ask questions and receive feedback constructively.
  • You have a passion for innovation and a curious mindset. You are willing to learn and develop new skills, industry knowledge, and keep up with technological developments in a constantly evolving industry.
  • You have basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for project tracking, quantity take-offs, and documentation purposes.


Required Education and Experience:

  • You have a bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • You have 1–3 years of CAD drafting experience, preferably in AutoCAD.
  • You have experience in the telecommunications industry, preferably with exposure to OSP design or construction.
  • You have the ability to read and interpret technical drawings, survey plans, and engineering specifications.


What you gain beyond the role:

  • Remote + Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the best of both worlds—collaborative office days when it counts, balanced with the freedom to work from home.

Here, flexibility isn't just a perk—it's how we help you perform at your best, without sacrificing life outside of work.

Why work for Sharesource?

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire hundreds of skillful individuals from a wide variety of backgrounds, genders, ages, and personalities to live out our diverse culture and make a positive impact on the world!

raw.description:
We're searching for some really great people who enjoy customers as much as we do.

Named as one of Puget Sound Business Journal’s Best Places to Work three years running, 2021, 2022 and 2023. We are a certified Great Place to Work™ and were named a Best Workplace in Financial Services and Insurance in 2021 and 2022.

Check out our rating at Working at Evergreen Home Loans | Great Place To Work®

Wow happens every day at Evergreen. Our vision is centered on changing the world one relationship at a time.

Learn more about us on our website here

Discover what’s possible with Evergreen.

We're looking to add people who feel the same way we do about our customers, our associates and the work we do. In return, you'll be part of a growing, contemporary company that rewards creative thinking and believes in helping you get to where you want to be. You'll also enjoy a healthy salary, a comprehensive benefits package and an attractive 401K plan to help you grow along with us!

Job Summary:

This position supports customers by processing loan payments, payoffs, and account maintenance, and entails management of accounting and reconciliation of mass data associated with payment processing from a vendor and individual level for multiple general ledger and clearing accounts. Cashiering function ensures proper application of all incoming payments through the various payment options established by the company. This will include Payoffs, ACH payments, wires, lockbox payments, online payments, and manually posted payments. This position leads and mentors staff to work effectively and follow credit reporting operational and regulatory compliance.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Manage the operations of the cashiering department
  • Analyze team results and provide reporting to senior management including aging, volumes, performance trending, and any issues that affect current or future production trending data.
  • Ensures proper application of all incoming payments through the various payment options established by the company. This includes both performing and default payments.
  • Oversee the completion of the payment processing functions and the distribution of cash processes daily
  • Maintains accurate records of each function with the cashiering department and ensures these functions are in line with state and agency requirements
  • Loans in the mortgage servicing portfolio must be serviced according to investor requirements and that accurate accounting and reporting records are maintained.
  • Establishes procedures for cash and ensures the proper controls are in place
  • Reports to government agencies as required.
  • Keeps informed on government regulations pertaining to loan servicing
  • Manages all aspects of the in-house lockbox operations through the cashiering department
  • Ensures all borrower funds are disbursed accordingly following payoff or loan removal

Performance Expectations:

  • Perform all actions in accordance with the Mission, Vision, and Convictions of EHL.
  • Manage the department to meet or exceed department productivity, production and/or financial metrics.
  • Provide a “WOW” experience and effectively communicate with associates, clients, partners, and vendors via phone, written communication, and/or in person.
  • Set clear expectations for associates and support their personal and professional growth through one-on-one meetings held on a semi-monthly or more frequent basis and annual performance reviews with all direct reports.
  • Address performance issues in a timely manner and document incidents.
  • Anticipate staffing issues, plan for staffing changes in advance, and complete recruiting activities monthly for branches, or as needed for departments in order to hire high quality associates to fully staff the team.
  • Host regular and timely communication with associates.
  • Understand the responsibilities of production and operations and act as a liaison between functions to develop collaborative team relationships so that loans close on time, and as promised.
  • Maintain basic knowledge of Evergreen’s HR, Onboarding, Payroll, and Accounting policies and systems and proactively consult applicable department when dealing with issues.
  • Exude a positive attitude, mentor associates, set a good example (this includes appropriate dress and demeanor).
  • Perform all actions in accordance with the policies and procedures of the company.
  • Have knowledge about Evergreen’s mortgage processes and products in order to answer questions and support staff.

Specific Skills/ Knowledge/ Abilities Required for Position:

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in cash posting in loan servicing for mortgage banking, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 1 - 3 years of management experience
  • Experience with Black Knight/MSP Loan Servicing Software a plus
  • Knowledge of state and federal laws and regulations applicable to mortgage and consumer lending with considerable knowledge of loan servicing practices
  • Analytical ability sufficient to apply data and information to the solution of administrative and operating problems
  • Considerable knowledge of workflow processes, staffing needs, and operational costs in a collection operation
  • Leadership and management skills with the ability to motivate, mentor, train, coach, evaluate performance, and lead a multi-functional staff in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Ability to work independently with minimal direction and to meet deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to read, interpret, and analyze accounts and records of a complex, detailed and recurring nature
  • Analytical ability sufficient to apply data and information to the solution of administrative and operating problems
  • Ability to prepare an operating budget, anticipate and explain variances
  • Ability to work collaboratively with peers, company managers, and customers in a team environment to attain common goals
  • Analytical and mathematical ability sufficient to calculate and evaluate performance metrics and apply them to increased efficiencies and the solution of administrative and operating barriers
  • Ability to communicate effectively both in writing and orally, in person and by telephone, with all levels of the organization and with external customers. Strong instructing and advising skills. Demonstrated ability to provide excellent customer service
  • Ability to enter and extract data from a computer database. Ability to locate data in a computer database for the purpose of researching and resolving customer inquiries
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality
  • Considerable knowledge of and ability to use automated accounting systems; ability to use personal computers, peripherals, business software, and applications specific to organizational needs
  • Must be comfortable working in a start-up dynamic environment
  • Exercise good judgment and strong character, motivated, hard working.
  • Ability to work well with fellow associates, clients and vendors.

Physical Requirements:

  • Requires all forms of dexterity and mobility throughout the shift, which may include extended periods of sitting and/or standing. Occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, twist, climb or balance, stoop, kneel crouch or crawl.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Must be able to speak and hear, lift and carry up to twenty-five pounds (25 lbs.) or occasionally more.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, occasionally noisy environment.
  • May be required to drive for business purposes and if so, must hold a driver’s license in good standing and maintain personal auto insurance in compliance with EHL’s Auto Insurance policy.

Compensation:

The salary range for this position is $58,400 - $113,300 per year depending on a number of factors including location and experience.

Benefits and Perks:

Eligible associates (and their families) have the option to enroll in medical, dental, and/or vision coverage of which both the associate and the company contribute towards expenses. Basic Life/AD&D insurance for eligible associates as well as a Short-term Disability benefit are provided by Evergreen. Additional Voluntary Life/AD&D, Long-term Disability benefits and Legal/ID protection plans paid for by the associate are also available. Associates are automatically enrolled in Evergreen’s 401(k) plan. Personal Time Off (PTO) of up to 13.34 hours may be earned monthly and associates may enjoy 9 paid holidays each year. Paid voluntary day of work, company matching on charitable donations and mortgage loan benefit.

Evergreen is an equal opportunity employer and E-Verify employer.

Title: Sales Development Representative

Function: Sales

Reports to: Director, Sales Development

Location: Australia - Remote

Position Summary:

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will be responsible for developing demand for the company's products and solutions. In this role, you will establish relationships with prospective customers to create a viable sales pipeline through marketing lead generation campaigns and direct outreach. You will play an integral part in conveying the value of the platform to potential clients, directly impacting the company's future success. Additionally, this role offers opportunities for growth and professional development both within and beyond the department.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead Qualification: Identify, engage, and qualify leads from various marketing channels (e.g., website, conferences, etc.) and ensure they align with the company’s solutions.

  • Conduct direct outreach to engage new leads while prospecting into a technical audience, applying a deep understanding of the B2B sales cycle, and effectively handling objections.
  • Analyze lead generation trends and optimize outreach efforts based on feedback and performance metrics.
  • Utilize phone, email, and social selling techniques to connect with key decision-makers, delivering compelling value propositions tailored to their needs.

Sales & Marketing Collaboration: Serve as a liaison between marketing and sales, actively engaging in marketing campaigns, analyzing trends, and collaborating with Account Executives to nurture key prospects and facilitate a seamless transition from prospecting to closing.

Quota Achievement: Engage new leads through direct outreach while developing a broader understanding of the B2B sales cycle, including prospecting into a technical audience and handling objections. Required to consistently meet or exceed assigned quotas for Booked Meetings and Sales Accepted Leads (SALs) contributing to overall revenue growth.

Pipeline & Performance Tracking: Consistently track and report key sales development metrics, including conversion rates, meeting attendance, and engagement trends.

Tools & Technology Usage: Use a variety of sales tools (SalesForce, etc.) to maintain and record detailed and accurate records of customer interactions and pipeline.

Gain experience in a fast-paced culture with corporate exposure while contributing to marketing strategies and developing professionally. Proactively seeks knowledge and stays informed about industry trends and innovations.

Skills & Experience Needed:

  • Bachelor's Degree Required
  • Minimum 1+ years of proven sales development experience (exceeding quota) or customer-facing role engaging prospects while demonstrating strong communication, adaptability, and professionalism.
  • Minimum 1+ years working within a CRM system (Salesforce experience preferred).
  • Must be an Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident currently based in Australia and willing to continue to work in Australia remotely
  • Develop and deliver compelling outreach through strong communication skills, while confidently speaking in front of an audience and handling objections effectively.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities, with a disciplined approach to prospecting and follow-ups.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment while maintaining a high level of self-motivation and discipline.
  • Comfortable speaking in front of an audience, whether in team meetings, client presentations, or sales pitches.
  • Demonstrate a growth mindset, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning, with a willingness to learn and be coached.

Competencies:

Accountability

Adaptability

Applied Learning

Business Acumen

Collaboration

Customer Focus

Dealing w/Ambiguity

Decision Making

Driving for Results

Initiating Action

Planning and Organizing

Technical/Professional Knowledge/Skills

With customers in higher education, nonprofit, healthcare systems, government, and enterprise business, OnBoard is the leading board management provider.

OnBoard has grown from a class project at Purdue University in West Lafayette, Indiana in 2003 into the world’s leading board management software platform today. Backed by JMI Equity and the acquisitions of eScribe and Govenda, OnBoard is positioned to become the industry leader in Board Management and Meeting Solutions for private and public sector entities.

raw.excerpt: Zelh is a fast-growing, passionate outsourcing company.
raw.description:
Zelh is a fast-growing, passionate outsourcing company.

Our mission is to be the most reliable company by offering and maintaining high-quality services consistently.

We achieve the mission by fostering long-term relationships with customers, employees, and vendors. Personal attention, timely communication, and respect for all people are the basis of our business philosophy!

We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Weekend Customer Operations Representative to support daily shipment coordination, customer communication, and operational execution across domestic and international freight movements.

This role sits at the center of customer operations. You will be responsible for ensuring shipments are accurately built in the TMS, proactively monitored, clearly communicated, and fully updated from pickup through final delivery.

Success in this role comes from consistency, urgency, communication discipline, and operational ownership.

This is not a passive support role. The right person proactively follows up, identifies risks before escalation, communicates clearly with customers and brokers, and keeps freight moving without gaps in visibility.

Role in one line

A logistics operations professional responsible for shipment building, tracking coordination, proactive customer updates, and operational communication across domestic and international freight movements.

What you will do:

Load Building & Shipment Setup

  • Review incoming Delivery Orders (DOs) and identify shipment requirements

  • Build and enter shipments accurately into the TMS

  • Confirm shipment setup completion via email:

    • Reply “received, thank you”

    • Add PO#, BKG#, or MBOL# into the email subject line as required

    • CC tracking teams and operational stakeholders appropriately

  • Ensure shipment data accuracy before operational execution begins

Load Coverage & Shipment Monitoring

  • Confirm all shipments are fully covered prior to scheduled pickup times

  • Escalate uncovered shipments to brokers at least 2 hours before pickup time

  • Monitor shipment progress and communicate operational delays proactively

  • Coordinate with internal teams regarding:

    • Recovery trucks

    • Carrier replacement

    • Service interruptions

    • Late pickups or deliveries

Customer Communication & Updates

Provide proactive shipment visibility and operational updates throughout the shipment lifecycle.

Daily Customer Updates

  • Send daily ETA updates to customers for pickup and delivery appointments

  • Include truck location details when shipments are already loaded

    • Example:

      • “Truck is currently in Houston, TX with ETA to delivery at 09:00 AM”

Pickup & Delivery Notifications

  • Notify customers immediately upon:

    • Driver arrival at shipper

    • Driver arrival at receiver

    • Driver departure from shipper

    • Driver departure from receiver

  • Include exact arrival and departure times in updates

Detention & Delay Communication

  • Notify customers when detention begins for OTR shipments (after 2 hours onsite)

  • Alert brokers immediately regarding:

    • Late pickups

    • Late deliveries

    • Missed appointments

    • Service risks

  • Assist with determining next operational steps:

    • Customer communication

    • Carrier replacement

    • Recovery truck coordination

Import & Export Shipment Coordination

  • Maintain and update shipment tracking charts for import and export freight

  • Update customer tracking sheets with:

    • Appointments

    • Container pull status

    • Container numbers

    • Holds or customs-related issues

    • Delivery updates

  • Monitor and communicate:

    • Container loading schedules

    • Delivery schedules

    • Port or terminal delays

    • Operational exceptions

  • Send final delivery documentation, charges, and PODs upon shipment completion

Requirements

  1. Previous logistics, freight operations, customer operations, dispatch, or transportation coordination experience preferred

  2. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously

  3. Excellent organizational and follow-up skills

  4. Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  5. Ability to provide clear, professional customer updates throughout the day

  6. Comfortable working in fast-paced transportation and logistics environments

  7. Ability to identify operational issues proactively and escalate appropriately

  8. Experience working with TMS systems and shipment tracking tools preferred

  9. Strong sense of urgency and accountability

  10. Ability to work independently in a remote environment

The strongest Customer Operations Representatives:

  • Stay ahead of problems before customers ask questions

  • Communicate proactively rather than reactively

  • Maintain extremely high attention to shipment details

  • Keep customers consistently informed without being prompted

  • Escalate issues early and clearly

  • Remain calm during high-volume operational situations

  • Understand that responsiveness and visibility directly impact customer trust

  • Treat every shipment as time-sensitive and customer-critical

Working conditions:

  • Work schedule: Thursday–Monday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST.

  • A supportive team

  • Competitive Salary in USD

  • Remote eligibility

  • 10+ business days of paid time off

  • Equipment provided

Join our team and become an integral part of our mission to provide reliable and efficient freight transportation solutions to our customers.

raw.excerpt: Why Pythian: At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence.
raw.description:
Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

We are looking for a Lead Cloud Engineer to design secure, scalable and cost-efficient cloud platforms, on Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and AWS. You will lead architecture on client engagements, guide engineering teams through delivery, and act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders. You will architect automation-first solutions across Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and AWS, lead engagements from presales to delivery, and set the engineering practices our teams build with.

If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian, reach out to us and find out!

Intrigued to see what a life is like at Pythian? Check out #pythianlife on LinkedIn and follow @loveyourdata on Instagram!

Not the right job for you? Check out what other great jobs Pythian has open around the world! Pythian Careers

What you will be doing:

  • Lead presales: technical discovery, solution design, estimates, proposals and SOWs, demos and proofs of concept.
  • Practice spec-driven development: turn requirements into clear specifications and acceptance criteria, then generate, test and iterate code against them.
  • Lead agent-assisted development: use AI coding agents to produce IaC, pipelines and migrations, with human review, automated tests and security guardrails.
  • Deliver everything through GitOps: no manual or console changes; every change is versioned, reviewed and deployed by pipeline.
  • Build reusable, versioned modules, templates and golden paths that teams and clients can consume and extend.
  • Expose automation through APIs and MCP servers so platforms can be driven by pipelines, tools and AI agents.
  • Codify landing zones, networking, identity and zero-trust security, aligned to the Well-Architected Framework.
  • Codify migrations and disaster recovery so any environment can be rebuilt on demand.
  • Embed policy-as-code, supply chain security, observability and FinOps into the delivery pipeline.
  • Architect AI/ML and GenAI platforms, including RAG and agentic AI workloads.
  • Mentor engineers and maintain the practice's standards, reference architectures and code libraries.

What we need from you:

  • 10+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, with 5+ years in an architect role.
  • Consulting or client-facing delivery experience.
  • Architecture experience across Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and AWS.
  • Automation-first mindset, with a track record of replacing manual and click-ops work with code.
  • Expert Terraform, and strong coding in Python or Go.
  • GitOps and CI/CD: Git workflows, pull-request reviews, automated testing and pipeline-driven deployments.
  • Agent-assisted and spec-driven development in daily practice (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini Code Assist).
  • Building APIs or MCP servers to expose automation.
  • IaC for networking, security, Kubernetes, and data pipelines and warehouses.
  • Testing infrastructure code: unit, integration and policy tests.
  • Presales experience: scoping, estimating and presenting solutions.
  • Strong communication and client-facing skills.

What will make you a strong candidate:

  • MLOps/LLMOps or agentic AI platform experience.
  • Building internal developer platforms or self-service portals.
  • Policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA or Sentinel.
  • Open-source contributions or published reusable modules.
  • Cloud architect certifications (Google Cloud, Azure or AWS).

What you will receive:

  • Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity.

HiringDisclaimer

  • The successful applicant will need to fulfill the requirements necessary to obtain a background check.
  • Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in any aspect of the selection process.

AI Disclaimer

Pythian may utilize Enterprise Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or features throughout its hiring process. These tools help us manage high volumes of applications efficiently and may be employed to review applications, analyze resumes, and assist with other recruitment steps. While Pythian uses AI in its hiring process, it does not substitute for human judgment. Our Talent Acquisition Team reviews all AI-generated recommendations, and the system is subject to regular bias audits to ensure fairness and compliance with all applicable employment and human rights laws. All final hiring decisions are made by, and remain the responsibility of, human decision-makers. By applying for this position, you consent to Pythian’s use of these AI tools in the evaluation of your application. You have the right to request a human review of any solely AI-driven decision or to request an accommodation. Should you require further details regarding the processing of your data, please reach out to us.

Job Title: Director, Social Media & Influencer Marketing

Location: Remote
