Company Summary

At Vytalogy, we believe everyone should have access to better health and nutrition to fuel their wellness. As a leader in the vitamins, minerals, and supplements (VMS) industry, we're home to trusted brands Natrol and Jarrow Formulas. With locations in Los Angeles, CA, Boulder, CO, and Haslet, TX, we bring science-backed wellness products to consumers nationwide.

Summary:

The Director, Social Media & Influencer Marketing will lead social media, creator, influencer and community marketing across Vytalogy's portfolio of brands, with primary emphasis on Natrol. This role will build a connected social and creator capability that translates brand strategy into culturally relevant content and consumer experiences across organic social, paid amplification, affiliate, community and social commerce. The Director will partner across Brand, eCommerce, Shopper Marketing and PR to strengthen brand relevance, deepen consumer engagement and contribute to measurable business growth across the portfolio.

Your primary activities will include but are not limited to:

  • Develop annual social media, influencer, creator and community strategies aligned with each brand's positioning, target consumer and growth priorities, with primary focus on accelerating Natrol's growth and cultural relevance
  • Define channel roles, content territories, editorial priorities and platform strategies across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and emerging social platforms
  • Translate brand strategy into social-first creative direction, briefs, content calendars and platform-native content
  • Build and lead an integrated creator ecosystem spanning celebrity and macro talent, influencers, micro-creators, ambassadors, affiliates and user-generated content

raw.description:
The Senior Vice President of Commercial Servicing sets the strategic leadership and executive oversight for the Commercial Servicing platform, including primary servicing, special servicing, portfolio management, operational controls, and oversight of the shared-service functions that support commercial loan servicing. This leader is accountable for building a scalable, high-performing platform that delivers compliant, efficient servicing, strong credit and asset-resolution outcomes, exceptional client experiences, and sustainable growth and profitability.

This position will establish the strategy, operating model, governance, talent, technology, and financial discipline required to support portfolio growth, new client on-boarding, securitization readiness, and the continued development of the loan servicing technology platforms and related servicing capabilities.

This highly visible role interfaces with executive leadership and represents Commercial Servicing with clients, investors, rating agencies, regulators, auditors, vendors, financing counterparties, and other external stakeholders. The position is responsible for balancing growth, service excellence, risk management, credit judgment, liquidity and advancing requirements, customer outcomes, and shareholder returns.

Job Functions and Responsibilities:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

  • Develop and execute the short- and long-term strategy for Commercial Servicing
  • Align servicing objectives with corporate growth, client, operational, financial, and risk-management goals.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing leadership team with clear accountability and succession planning.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  • Own the Commercial Servicing P&L performance; develop and manage budgets, forecasts, staffing plans, and investment priorities.
  • Provide executive oversight of portfolio performance, delinquencies, watch-list activity, advancing, liquidity, recoverability, credit risk, asset resolutions, loss mitigation, foreclosure, bankruptcy, REO, and special-servicing strategies.
  • Act as executive relationship manager for key clients, investors, special servicers, directing certificate holders, rating agencies, auditors, regulators, vendors, and financing partners; maintain regular contact and lead resolution of significant issues.
  • Drive operating excellence through process redesign, automation, data analytics, artificial intelligence, standardized controls, quality assurance, and technology modernization, including continued optimization of proprietary commercial technology platforms.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory, contractual, investor, licensing, and internal governance requirements.
  • Oversee the proactive identification, assessment, mitigation, and reporting of key business risks, including operational, regulatory, credit, technology, vendor, information security, and reputational exposures.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of executive communications, business reviews, portfolio and financial analytics, strategic insights, client updates, and rating agency materials to support informed decision-making and stakeholder engagement

Key Result Areas:

  • Achieve portfolio growth, client retention, revenue, profitability, and return objectives while maintaining disciplined expense and advancing management.
  • Successfully onboard new clients, portfolios, products, and asset classes while maintaining service quality, operational stability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Improve portfolio performance by reducing delinquencies, accelerating asset resolution timelines, maximizing advance recoveries, strengthening watchlist management, and minimizing credit losses.
  • Increase organizational scalability, productivity, and cost efficiency through process standardization, automation, artificial intelligence, technology modernization, and data-driven decision making.
  • Enhance client, investor, rating-agency, and stakeholder satisfaction through strong service delivery, transparent communication, and effective relationship management.
  • Strengthening the commercial servicing platform's market position by supporting business development initiatives, securitization readiness, strategic partnerships, and expansion into targeted commercial and business-purpose lending segments.
  • Develop and retain a high-performing leadership team by building organizational capability, succession plans, accountability, and employee engagement.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must have the following education and/or experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Real Estate, or a related field (or equivalent experience) required; advanced degree or relevant professional designation preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in commercial real estate finance, commercial loan servicing, special servicing, asset management, structured finance, or related financial services.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing growth strategies that drive portfolio expansion, revenue growth, profitability, market penetration, client acquisition, and new product introduction.
  • Proven experience scaling servicing platforms through subservicing relationships, client onboarding, operating model design, and large-scale business transformation.
  • Deep expertise in commercial and business-purpose loan servicing, including small-balance commercial, DSCR, RTL/fix-and-flip, SFR, multi-property, Multi-family, CRE, CMBS securitizations, subserviced – Master, Primary, and special-serviced portfolios.
  • Strong financial, accounting, and operational management skills, including P&L ownership, budgeting, forecasting, servicing economics, liquidity and advance management, resource allocation, valuation, and return-on-investment analysis.
  • Proven ability to leverage technology, automation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, and process improvement methodologies to enhance scalability, productivity, controls, client experience, and business performance.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate complex financial, operational, credit, and risk-related matters and translate insights into actionable business decisions.
  • Exceptional executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to build credibility and influence across executive leadership, boards, clients, investors, regulators, rating agencies, and strategic partners.
  • Proven ability to lead high-performing organizations, develop leadership talent, drive accountability, and successfully manage change in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple locations and time zones and travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

Training / Licensing Requirements:

  • Must pass the Company’s Background Screening process prior to beginning employment. Additionally, as a condition of employment, the successful candidate may be required to satisfy client-specific background screening or federal/state licensing requirements, if applicable.

The salary range for this position is expected to be $220,000 – $250,000 per year, depending on geographic location, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for bonus and long-term incentive compensation awards based on performance and subject to the terms of the Company’s applicable plans.

Culture & Continuous Improvement

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced payroll specialist to join Rippling’s Global Payroll Operations team. We are rapidly expanding Rippling to serve the needs of employees and employers all over the world. Our Global Payroll Operations team plays a critical role in ensuring the success of our global payroll products, which are natively built and fully integrated with Rippling’s broader suite of products.

As Rippling expands its product offerings globally, there is a critical business need for Rippling to develop new muscles around global product operations and country-specific payroll expertise outside of the US.

This role, Global Payroll Operations Specialist, is a critical hire for the Global Payroll Operations team that will be fully dedicated to developing and executing these new capabilities. This role will own all operational aspects across select countries, relationships with our external partners, and drive our expansion into new customer segments and geographies. Additionally, this role brings critical country-specific payroll expertise to support the development of our natively built payroll software.

This is an exciting role that requires significant cross-departmental engagement with a major impact on the product and customer experience.

  • Execute timely payroll, filings, and payments for all customers across key countries

HealthMark Group is a leading provider of healthcare release of information solutions, dedicated to simplifying and streamlining the exchange of medical data between healthcare providers, payers, and patients. Job Summary

HealthMark Group is seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Payroll Specialist to support and execute all aspects of the company's payroll operations. This individual will be responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing for a growing, multi-state workforce.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing full-cycle payroll, a strong understanding of payroll regulations and tax requirements, and proficiency with ADP Workforce Now. This role requires a high level of accuracy, organization, confidentiality, and the ability to collaborate effectively with Human Resources, Finance, and external payroll and benefits providers.

Responsibilities:

  • Process and administer all biweekly payroll cycles, supporting approximately 100 payroll runs annually, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.
  • Review, audit, and validate employee timecards, hours worked, overtime, paid time off, holidays, bonuses, referral incentives, military leave, and other payroll-related earnings and deductions.
  • Maintain accurate payroll records and ensure employee changes, including new hires, terminations, status changes, and compensation adjustments, are properly reflected in payroll.
  • Utilize ADP Workforce Now to process payroll, maintain employee payroll information, research discrepancies, and troubleshoot payroll-related issues.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local wage and hour laws, payroll tax regulations, and applicable reporting requirements.
  • Assist with multi-state payroll processing, including applicable tax withholding, wage requirements, and jurisdictional regulations.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for employee payroll inquiries, managing the payroll mailbox and providing timely, professional responses regarding paychecks, deductions, tax withholdings, and other payroll matters.
  • Coordinate with Human Resources and Finance to ensure payroll changes and employee transactions are accurately communicated and processed.
  • Reconcile payroll reports, deductions, tax liabilities, and payroll-related accounts to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Assist with quarterly payroll tax filings, year-end processing, W-2 preparation, and required payroll reporting.
  • Support payroll-related audits and provide documentation as requested.
  • Coordinate with third-party administrators and providers regarding 401(k) contributions, benefits deductions, insurance, and other payroll-related matters.
  • Assist with monthly accounting close procedures by preparing payroll reports, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes, reporting, and internal controls to increase efficiency and accuracy.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of employee compensation, tax information, and other sensitive payroll records.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of hands-on payroll processing experience, preferably supporting a mid-sized or large employee population.
  • Strong working knowledge of full-cycle payroll processing and applicable federal, state, and local payroll regulations.
  • Experience with ADP Workforce Now is strongly required
  • Experience processing multi-state payroll is required
  • Strong understanding of wage and hour requirements, overtime calculations, payroll deductions, tax withholdings, and paid leave administration.
  • Experience with payroll reconciliations, audits, quarterly reporting, and year-end W-2 processes.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to analyze payroll data, reconcile reports, and identify discrepancies.
  • Experience working with accounting or ERP systems; NetSuite experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with 401(k) contributions, benefits deductions, insurance premiums, and coordination with third-party administrators.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict payroll deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to provide professional employee support.
  • Ability to handle confidential employee and financial information with discretion and professionalism.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting payroll for a growing organization with employees across multiple states.
  • Previous experience working within a centralized HR and Finance environment.

Note: This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position and does not encompass all job-related responsibilities and requirements. The responsibilities and qualifications may be subject to change as the needs of the organization evolve.

This role does or may require regular access to Protected Health Information (PHI) and/or confidential client data. The incumbent must demonstrate a strong understanding of confidentiality requirements, adhere to all HIPAA regulations and organizational privacy and security policies, and report any known or suspected unauthorized access, use, or disclosure of PHI immediately to the Privacy Officer or Information Security team. This position requires timely completion of all required company-sponsored and regulatory training programs

raw.excerpt: About Cozey At Cozey, we're building a world-class organization with the ambition to become the world's leading furniture company.
raw.description:
About Cozey
At Cozey, we're building a world-class organization with the ambition to become the world's leading furniture company. We're diligent, innovative, and relentless about empowering more possibilities in our customers' homes and making furniture shopping as easy as possible, so that they can simply focus on enjoying their homes. Our commonsense furniture innovations adapt to evolving lifestyles, combining ingenuity with a commitment to great value and customer service. As a fast-growing company, our success is driven by a team that shares our passion for redefining the furniture experience and building a world-class brand. That same growth is why we're looking for a Senior Supply Planner to make sure the right products are in the right place at the right time, so every customer gets the fast, reliable experience they expect from Cozey.

The Mission of the Senior Supply and Inventory Planning Analyst at Cozey

Reporting to our Manager, Supply Planning, you'll decide how much inventory Cozey buys and where it sits. You'll turn demand forecasts into buy and deployment plans across our fulfillment centers, and weigh in-stock against working capital every week. You'll be the person leadership trusts to recommend what we buy, when, and why.

This is a remote role open to candidates across Canada. Please note that our team works core hours in Eastern Time (ET), so you'll need to be available during those hours.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own end-to-end supply planning for an assigned portfolio of products, suppliers, and markets, and keep a strong weekly planning rhythm as Cozey scales.
  • Translate demand forecasts into purchasing requirements and replenishment strategies across SKUs, suppliers, and distribution nodes, accounting for lead times, MOQs, and supplier constraints.
  • Own days of inventory on hand for your portfolio. Decide where inventory sits, balancing service levels, working capital, and cost through decisions on safety stock, order sizing, expedites, and allocation; monitor stockouts and excess or slow-moving inventory, and correct course as needed.
  • Continuously optimize planning parameters, including lead times, safety stock, reorder points, and batch sizes, based on observed performance and variability.
  • Partner with Sourcing and Operations to monitor supplier lead times, capacity, reliability, and fill rates, providing the forecasts, order requirements, and planning insights needed to support supplier discussions and drive corrective action when performance falls short.
  • Prepare and present supply risks, constraints, and recommendations (expedites, reallocation, buys, order changes) to support S&OP decision-making.
  • Partner with Demand Planning, Product, Operations, and Finance on product launches, lifecycle transitions, and discontinuations to ensure clean, in-stock execution.
  • Shape our in-house planning tools with Data Science and Engineering: define the logic, test it against real decisions, and flag where it breaks.

We'd Love to Hear from You If You Have

  • 4+ years of experience in supply planning, inventory planning, operations, or supply chain analytics in retail, e-commerce, or CPG, including experience operating in complex environments with global sourcing and long lead times.
  • Strong supply planning fundamentals: replenishment logic, safety stock, lead times, MOQ constraints, and service level trade-offs.
  • Strong analytical and technical skills, including advanced Excel, a working knowledge of SQL, and comfort with planning systems and BI tools, paired with attention to detail: clean data, accurate parameters, and reliable execution with minimal downstream rework.
  • Experience using automation and AI-enabled tools to improve planning workflows, analyze large datasets, and accelerate decision-making.
  • An operational mindset, understanding how plans play out across sourcing, production, warehouses, and transportation.
  • Clear, structured communication that lays out the issue, impact, options, and recommendation, paired with a bias for action: spotting risks early and driving fixes before they hit service or inventory.

You'll Know You're Successful When

  • Inventory is healthy across your scope: strong in-stock performance, with excess and obsolescence under control.
  • Supply plans are reliable and realistic, aligned with operational constraints, with minimal last-minute firefighting.
  • Risks like capacity, delays, or shortages are caught early, and your recommendations turn into real action.
  • Supplier performance risks are visible and addressed proactively in partnership with Sourcing, including lead-time variability, fill-rate issues, and capacity constraints.
  • Planning parameters keep improving, and that shows up in better performance over time.
  • Leaders trust your supply plan enough to make purchasing and inventory decisions against it.

We Care About You

  • You will receive a competitive salary along with a comprehensive benefits package.
  • Real influence over how Cozey plans, buys, and grows its inventory, with decisions that directly shape the business.
  • Endless opportunities for personal and professional growth in a fast-growing, ambitious company.
  • A generous PTO policy that gives you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible, people-first workspace where you're surrounded by smart, kind, and humble colleagues.

Please note that we may use AI-powered tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as application screening and interview coordination. These tools help us focus our time where it matters most: getting to know candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people, and we're committed to a fair and inclusive process.

Overview:

As a Data Engineer at Sagent, you will help build an entirely new data ecosystem that forms the backbone of our next-generation, event- and API-based financial servicing platform. This platform is being built from the ground up as a cloud-enabled, real-time, data-first solution, and your work will shape how data is collected, moved, stored, and trusted across it.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on data engineering expert who brings deep knowledge of data integration, migration, and pipeline development on a modern cloud platform. You will collaborate with data analysts, architects, and product and engineering teams to design scalable data solutions that support our mortgage servicing platform and analytics initiatives.

Your day-to-day at Sagent:

Data Integration and Pipeline Development:

  • Create data collection frameworks for structured and unstructured data.
  • Develop and maintain data integration pipelines (ETL or native cloud pipelines), including data warehousing and online transactional processing (OLTP).
  • Implement ETL pipelines within and outside of a data warehouse using SQL and Python.
  • Develop scripts for loading, extracting, and transforming data.
  • Implement data load strategies to relational databases and cloud data warehouses, and build data integration through distributed data processing pipelines.
  • Handle both batch and streaming data using event streaming and cloud-based big-data processing technologies.
  • Support data movement using microservices (direct ingestion), where applicable.

Cloud Data Solutions and Design:

  • Serve as a hands-on subject matter expert in data movement, integration, and migration on a modern cloud platform and related technologies.
  • Work with teams to design and implement modern, scalable data solutions using new and emerging cloud technologies.

This role will manage strategic data provider relationships that support business strategy, product innovation, and market growth, while partnering closely with product, analytics, legal, compliance, finance, and technology teams to bring high-value data assets into the business. The role will ensure data is responsibly sourced, aligned to business needs, and positioned for long-term value through effective onboarding, governance, and supplier management.

  • Build and manage relationships with data suppliers, serving as the primary point of coordination throughout the acquisition lifecycle

  • Monitor supplier performance, manage ongoing governance activities, and help address issues, renewals, and contract-related decisions

  • Ensure all acquisition activities align with internal policies, risk standards, and regulatory requirements

  • Demonstrated expertise in mobile identity and phone intelligence at a global scale, including practical knowledge of data sources, market dynamics, and use cases across regions.

  • Understanding of regulatory requirements across multiple countries and industries governing the use of phone numbers and phone intelligence data.

  • Experienced in contract negotiations, including negotiating commercial and contractual terms with external partners and suppliers.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, issues, and deadlines concurrently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

** This is an opportunity to join our top-notch product delivery team working closely together on interesting projects for our clients. This position is fully remote (indefinitely).**

Emergent Software is seeking a Technical Product Manager to lead the planning and delivery of custom software solutions for enterprise clients. You'll work closely with stakeholders, developers, architects, and executives to define product strategy, gather requirements, manage priorities, and guide projects from concept through delivery. The ideal candidate has 7+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, a strong understanding of modern web application development, and a passion for solving complex business challenges through technology. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a client-facing consulting environment and enjoys bridging the gap between business goals and technical execution.

Highlights & Benefits of working at Emergent Software

  • Work closely with other talented software engineers and analysts. Our vetting process means you can count on your team members to know what they are talking about.

  • Work from home or work remotely from anywhere you want

  • Flexible work schedule meaning you can work regular hours or whenever you work best

  • Work-life balance is essential and highly valued at Emergent Software. If you choose to work more than 40 hours, you’ll be compensated for the extra work!

  • Work on interesting projects solving complex business problems with custom software.

  • 100 hours per year to focus on your professional development. We invest in your growth!

  • Profit sharing bonus means as we’re successful, you’re successful

  • Excellent benefits package including medical insurance, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, FSA, disability, life insurance, and paid parental leave

Primary Duties

  • Partner with Clients

    • Establish a strategic roadmap, product vision and backlog.

    • Partner with clients to assist them in performing the Product Owner role.

    • Facilitate in-depth requirements gathering and analysis.

    • Document requirements as Features and User Stories to share with team.

    • Work with your team and client to create a plan for delivering on project objectives and achieving business value.

  • Partner with the Product Delivery Team

    • Provide support, guidance, and mentorship to colleagues in the Product Delivery Team.

    • Drive innovation and adoption of AI tooling in product development and delivery.

    • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and a community of practitioners.

    • Help craft future product offerings or client engagement options.

  • Partner with Sales

    • Lead product development activities for key/strategic client pursuits.

    • Present solution vision proposals to client executives.

    • Work with account executives on client satisfaction efforts in existing delivery engagements.

  • Partner with Technology Teams

    • Establish client technology roadmap.

    • Collaborate heavily with technology experts (architects and engineers) to vet requirements for technical feasibility.

    • Speak with intelligence on technology topics to clients to establish trust and confidence.

  • Partner with Delivery Teams

    • Execute on established plans.

    • Communicate technical and business requirements to delivery team.

    • Collaborate with senior delivery team members to solve complex challenges.

    • Demonstrate strong understanding of custom software development concepts and best practices in all interactions.

    • Ensure projects stay on target by regularly communicating status, risks, and change as they occur.

  • Be a Champion of the Agile Software Development Process

    • Work directly with clients to manage project delivery while encouraging and fostering an agile delivery method.

    • Apply agile concepts in real world settings, adapting principles to client’s level of agile sophistication and working to improve maturity over time.

    • Own backlog health and communicate deviation to expected value delivery proactively.

    • Act as a servant leader to your delivery team.

Required Qualifications

  • Product Ownership Experience

    • 7+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager

    • Experience in delivering custom enterprise software solutions across a variety of technologies, platforms, and hosting paradigms.

    • Experience in crafting cost estimates to deliver components or entire projects.

    • Strong technical writing, verbal communication, and presentation skills are a must.

    • Experience operating as the liaison between agile development teams and users in defining requirements, performing business analysis, and driving delivery in the right direction.

  • Technology Knowledge

    • Experience utilizing AI tools in product development, product delivery, or project management.

    • A solid understanding of how websites, web applications, APIs, databases, and the cloud function at a high level.

    • Strong technical background enabling you to provide credible leadership to development teams and accurately evaluate complex project risks and issues.

  • Experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach

    • Solid understanding of software development life cycle models including expert knowledge of Agile principles.

    • Experience with agile work organization tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, Trello, Basecamp, Rally).

    • A proven track record of successfully implementing custom web application projects using Agile methodologies.

  • Experience with Traditional Project Management Concepts

    • Experience with scope, schedule, budget, and risk management.

    • Must be viewed as a trusted source of truth by stakeholders through consistent, transparent, and confident communication.

    • Owns the narrative around project delivery, ensuring stakeholders are informed, aligned, and reassured throughout the lifecycle.

  • Occasional travel to client sites may be requested for activities such as annual planning meetings. Although travel is not expected to be frequent, the ability to accommodate occasional travel is required.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Strong preference towards candidates with experience delivering projects to client expectations, especially in a consulting capacity, software as a service environment, or delivering AI-accelerated (agentic) solutions.

  • Industry recognized Agile process certification (PMI-ACP, Scrum Alliance CSM or CSPO, Scrum.org PAL, SAFe, or equivalent).

  • Industry recognized Project management certification (PMP or equivalent).

  • Microsoft Azure technology certifications (AZ-900, DP-900, AI-900).

  • Experience on projects utilizing Microsoft stack technologies such as .NET, SQL Server, and Azure as well as JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, and Vue.js.

  • Some examples of profiles/backgrounds that we feel would do well in this role:

    • Scrum master turned product owner.

    • Independent consultant with previous experience on agile delivery teams (any role).

    • Someone who is a product owner with a passion for the technical side of software development.

Our Vetting Process

At Emergent Software, we work hard to find the best analysts capable of delivering high quality software for our clients. If you think you’re one of those, please understand that the effort put into this by people like yourself helps us be successful in surrounding you with other top-notch people. Here are the steps of our vetting process for this position:

  1. Application (5 minutes)

  2. Online Assessment (40-50 minutes)

  3. Initial Phone Interview & Technology Knowledge Assessment (45 minutes)

  4. Challenge Interview (90 minutes)

  5. Final Interview (60-90 minutes)

  6. Job Offer!

Benefits Package Details

This is a remote position.

Wanderlog is hiring a full-time engineer to help build and scale our web and mobile travel planning products. This is a permanent, full-time role reporting to the co-founders at Wanderlog.
Role details

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Location: Remote — United States

  • Reports to: Co-founders

  • Salary range: $70,000 - $100,000 USD, depending on experience

About Wanderlog

Wanderlog helps make leisure travel easier. We believe that travel makes the world better, and are building tools that lower the bar to it.

Our core product, built starting in 2019, is a travel planning app, but we’re also helping travelers book hotels (without hidden fees), providing them with information through pages such as best attractions and restaurants, and more.

We’re a small, engineering- and product-driven team building tools used by travelers worldwide.

Wanderlog was founded by twin brothers Peter Xu (ex-Stripe, McKinsey) and Harry Yu (ex-Google), who previously built successful travel products before starting Wanderlog.

What you'll do

As an engineer, you’ll be responsible for owning portions of the product. You’ll be expected to:

  • Build new features on our website and mobile app. (Our stack is Javascript (Typescript): modern React on the web, React Native on mobile, and Node.js/Express on the server.)
  • Design and decide what to build based on what would help travelers and drive growth. You won’t be handed a spec; you’ll be coming up with it!
  • Build data pipelines to crawl, process, and synthesize data from various sources around the web.
  • Write tests and build out engineering infrastructure. Our code is fully typed (Typescript) and tested.
  • Debug and fix bugs and scale the infrastructure as it grows.
  • Review code written by other engineers.
  • Be fast and nimble: figure out the best way to build new features at the lowest cost in time and future technical debt.
What you might work on
  • New, user-friendly hotel booking interfaces that make finding a place to stay easier.
  • AI-powered tools that read articles and watch videos for you and summarize the places they mention.
  • Improvements to our React Native mobile app so that it runs faster on slower Android phones.
  • A Chrome extension to let travelers quickly compare possible places to visit, airfares, and hotels.
  • Better invite and collaboration tools to encourage people to use Wanderlog to get more friends to join them.
  • A better profile page that lets travelers on Wanderlog show off where they’ve been, see how many people they’ve helped, and follow other friends and their trips.
What it's like to work here

We’re an engineering- and product-heavy team. A typical week involves talking to users, prioritizing tasks, designing in Figma, and continuously building and shipping improvements.

Our values include putting travelers first, owning the product end-to-end, treating teammates with respect, and moving fast by being thoughtful about what we build.

We believe work should fit into your life. We also hold twice-annual travel off sites to collaborate more closely and enjoy visiting new places together.

Hiring process
  • Two short asynchronous programming challenges, including an automated coding assessment
  • A live coding interview with one of the founders
  • A half-day final-round virtual onsite conducted via video call

Requirements

  • Are a Javascript developer comfortable with React and/or React Native.
  • Are a product person: you’ve built products end-to-end before, and really care about the people who use them.
  • Are comfortable with picking up various technologies for the task at hand. We quickly evaluate libraries and tools that could help our product, and variously use Redis, Elasticsearch, and Python as needed too.
  • Are entrepreneurial: excited about joining a small, high-growth team and talking to users, doing product and design, and wearing a variety of hats.
  • Love travel and believe in it as a positive force personally and for the world.

Benefits

  • Medical
  • Vision
  • Dental
  • FSA or HSA plans
  • Paid sick leave

deine aufgaben

Worum es geht
Der 1st Level nimmt die Tickets an und sortiert vor. Ab da bist du dran. Webstack-Fehler eingrenzen, Mailprobleme debuggen, Konfigurationen auf Systemebene korrigieren. Wenn ein Thema dreimal vorkommt, schreibst du ein Runbook.

Was du bei uns machst

  • L2-Tickets bearbeiten: Webstack-Fehler eingrenzen, Mail-Zustellbarkeit debuggen, Konfigurationsprobleme in Hosting-Umgebungen lösen, Backup-/Restore-Fälle auf Systemebene durchführen
  • Fehler analysieren und beheben: Ursachen eingrenzen, kontrolliert lösen, so dokumentieren, dass Kollegen den Fall jederzeit übernehmen könnten
  • Standard-Changes durchführen: Wiederherstellungen, Konfigurationsanpassungen, Monitoring-Follow-ups im Managed-Betrieb
  • Eskalationen vorbereiten: Komplexere Fälle mit Logs, Tests und klarer Abgrenzung an Spezialisten übergeben
  • Support weiterentwickeln: Wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder in Runbooks und Checklisten überführen

dein profil

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Linux-Systembetrieb: Shell-sicher, Dienste und Logs verstehen, Konfigurationen kontrolliert ändern
  • Web- und Mail-Stack: Erfahrung mit Webservern (z. B. NGINX, Apache), PHP-Runtimes (z. B. PHP-FPM), Datenbanken (z. B. MySQL, MariaDB) und gängigen Mailserver-Setups
  • Hosting-Grundlagen: DNS, SSL/TLS, Domainverwaltung, typische Zugriffs- und Recovery-Wege (Rescue, Konsole, IPMI) sowie ein Verständnis für die Unterschiede zwischen Shared Hosting, VPS und Dedicated
  • Strukturierte Fehleranalyse: Du gehst Probleme systematisch an und dokumentierst, was du getan hast
  • Kommunikation: Gutes Deutsch, technisches Englisch. Klar und verbindlich gegenüber Kunden und im Team. Wer etwas nicht weiß, fragt nach.
Plus, wenn du es hast: Hosting-Panels (z. B. Plesk) · Virtualisierung (z. B. KVM, Proxmox) · Monitoring (z. B. checkmk, Grafana) · Ansible/Shell-Skripting · Windows/AD-Basics

warum wir?

Was du dafür bekommst

  • 100 % remote, freie Hardware-Wahl. Linux-Setups ausdrücklich willkommen
  • Home-Office-Zuschuss
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Fachliche Weiterentwicklung: Ob Richtung Systemadministration, Netzwerk oder Entwicklung. Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dich in die Richtung zu bewegen, die zu dir passt.
  • Ein kleines Team, in dem man sich kennt und nicht hinter Ticketnummern verschwindet
So läuft die Bewerbung
Bewerbung unter Beantwortung einiger Fragen → Videocall zum Kennenlernen (ca. 30 Minuten) → Videocall mit Interview und Work Samples (ca. 90 Minuten) → Entscheidung.

Lyntris brings together the talents of Accelint and Vitesse teams under one mission, with each contributing deep expertise within their domain. Combining differentiated hardware, software and mission expertise, Lyntris helps customers sense threats, make sense of complex conditions and act with greater speed, precision and confidence in contested environments.

Lyntris supports U.S. and allied defense organizations across every branch — including Navy, Army, Air Force, Space Force and allied partners — spanning strategic, operational and tactical missions and every domain: Space, Air, Land, Sea and Cyber. With more than 200 active defense programs, Lyntris works at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge.

Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over. raw.excerpt: 🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy ¿Trabajas en una biblioteca, archivo o museo público, o preparas estas oposiciones?
raw.description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Trabajas en una biblioteca, archivo o museo público, o preparas estas oposiciones? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy y ayuda a otros a conseguir su plaza.

📚 Buscamos preparadores/as para las oposiciones de Bibliotecas, Archivos y Museos

Queremos construir un claustro de preparadores especializados en Bibliotecas, Archivos y Museos, en el que cada profesional aporte su experiencia en su ámbito y en su nivel.

No necesitas dominar todas las categorías. Puedes especializarte en Bibliotecas, Archivos o Museos, y en uno o varios niveles: Auxiliar, Ayudante o Facultativo/Conservador.

🗂️ Oposiciones para las que buscamos preparadores

⭐ Auxiliares (C1 / C2)

  • Auxiliar de Bibliotecas

  • Auxiliar de Archivos

  • Auxiliar de Museos

Se convocan sobre todo en comunidades autónomas, ayuntamientos, diputaciones y universidades, con denominaciones y grupo que varían según la administración.

⭐ Ayudantes (A2)

  • Ayudantes de Bibliotecas

  • Ayudantes de Archivos

  • Ayudantes de Museos

En el Estado, Cuerpo de Ayudantes de Archivos, Bibliotecas y Museos. En otras administraciones, escalas equivalentes con su propia denominación.

Facultativos y Conservadores (A1)

  • Facultativos de Bibliotecas

  • Facultativos de Archivos

  • Conservadores de Museos

En el Estado, Cuerpo Facultativo de Archiveros, Bibliotecarios y Arqueólogos y Cuerpo Facultativo de Conservadores de Museos. En otras administraciones, escalas superiores equivalentes.

🏛️ Una misma profesión, muchas convocatorias

Estas oposiciones las convocan administraciones muy distintas, y cada una tiene su denominación, su temario y su forma de examinar. Buscamos preparadores que conozcan procesos selectivos de:

  • Administración General del Estado / Ministerio de Cultura

  • Comunidades Autónomas

  • Ayuntamientos y otras entidades locales

  • Diputaciones

  • Universidades públicas

  • Otros organismos públicos

En las convocatorias autonómicas, locales y universitarias, la normativa y los sistemas de cada territorio o institución marcan la diferencia. Por eso queremos contar con preparadores de todas las comunidades autónomas.

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Profesionales con plaza (funcionarios/as o personal laboral fijo, en activo o en excedencia) en bibliotecas, archivos o museos públicos.

  • Preparadores/as con experiencia en estas oposiciones.

  • Personas capaces de trabajar las dos caras de la oposición:

    • el contenido técnico de la profesión (biblioteconomía, archivística, museología, gestión de colecciones, normalización…),

    • y la legislación y el contenido específico de la administración que convoca, incluida la normativa autonómica cuando corresponda.

  • Quienes dominen las pruebas prácticas: catalogación y clasificación, descripción archivística, documentación de fondos museográficos…

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: explicar con claridad, dar feedback útil y ayudar a sostener la preparación.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales. Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu ámbito, tu nivel y tu disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online del temario técnico y del temario específico de cada administración.

  • Supuestos prácticos: diseñarlos, resolverlos y corregir los de los alumnos.

  • Legislación de patrimonio, bibliotecas, archivos y museos, estatal y autonómica.

  • Preguntas tipo test y simulacros con el formato real.

  • Preparación de pruebas orales o de desarrollo, en los niveles superiores.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos: resolver dudas y ayudarles a avanzar.

  • Temarios, esquemas, resúmenes y vídeos cortos.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si tienes plaza, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene tres pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu ámbito (bibliotecas, archivos o museos), tu nivel, en qué comunidad autónoma trabajas y qué administraciones conoces.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba y entrevista. Agendarás tu entrevista y, antes de la fecha, nos enviarás una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos: la explicación de un contenido del temario o la resolución de un supuesto práctico (por ejemplo, un ejercicio de catalogación o de descripción archivística), con un material de apoyo creado por ti. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

Si conoces el camino hacia una plaza en bibliotecas, archivos o museos y quieres ayudar a otros a recorrerlo, queremos conocerte.

👉 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy.

raw.description:
We are looking for a Director, Product Management – Search & Match to shape and drive our core algorithm, ranking, discovery, and recommendation product strategies. Reporting to the VP of AI & Platform Products, you will act as a key product and business partner, translating complex data systems into high-impact executive narratives, commercial growth levers, and seamless marketplace experiences. This role requires an experienced leader who blends strong business sense with high-impact executive presentation skills to align senior stakeholders, optimize platform resource allocation, and lead cross-functional product teams.

Search & Match is the core intelligence engine powering our platform’s two-sided marketplace. It drives both sides of the matching equation: enabling job seekers to discover relevant roles (B2C) and helping employers and recruiters surface qualified candidates and resumes (B2B). These intelligent discovery mechanics directly power overall engagement, retention, and enterprise platform adoption.

About this team

Our mission is to provide the best-in-class job search tools that drive the best outcomes for job seekers and provide long term value for our brand. This team works cross-functionally with Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Design, and Finance to achieve business goals.

What you'll do

Shape and Drive Two-Sided Marketplace Strategy

  • Align Strategy to Business Impact: Define and own the multi-year strategy and roadmap for Search & Match, directly linking algorithmic advancements to core business outcomes, enterprise customer value, and job seeker engagement.
  • Dual-Sided Marketplace Discovery: Drive search, ranking, and recommendation strategies across both consumer-facing search (job seekers discovering opportunities) and B2B search mechanics (employers and sourcers searching resume databases and candidate pipelines).
  • Resource & ROI Stewardship: Govern functional team capacity, compute/infrastructure investments, and feature prioritization—balancing trade-offs between performance, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Market & Competitive Positioning: Evaluate industry trends in search, vector embeddings, and machine learning to position our dual-sided matching engine as a premier market differentiator.

Executive Influence & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Executive Storytelling & Presentation: Translate complex search performance, algorithmic models, and marketplace dynamics into clear, compelling narratives and board-ready presentations for executive leadership.
  • Build Cross-Functional Coalitions: Drive strategic consensus across Engineering, Data Science, UX, Enterprise GTM, and Consumer Operations—ensuring alignment on roadmap sequencing and operational trade-offs.
  • Lead Through Change: Guide functional teams through strategic pivots, shifting organizational priorities, and technology evolutions with structured rationale and strong clarity.

Drive Operational Excellence & Execution

  • Orchestrate Execution at Scale: Lead cross-functional product squads across match scoring, candidate indexing, search relevance, and recommendation feeds to ensure predictable, high-velocity delivery.
  • Systems & Marketplace Metrics: Establish clear performance metrics to measure search precision, recall, candidate-to-job match relevance, search latency, and reciprocal marketplace liquidity.
  • Culture of Experimentation: Oversee rigorous A/B testing and experimentation protocols to continuously refine discovery algorithms for both candidate and recruiter touchpoints.

Build and Develop High-Performing Teams

  • Mentorship & Talent Pipeline: Coach and develop Product Managers, instilling strong business sense, strategic thinking, user empathy, and executive communication skills.
  • Evolve Product Rituals: Establish operational frameworks, governance rituals, and decision-making standards that foster velocity and transparency across teams.

What you'll need

  • 8–10+ years of experience in product management, with significant experience leading two-sided marketplaces, search engines, recommendation systems, or match platforms.
  • Proven Executive Presence: Exceptional presentation and storytelling abilities—able to influence executive leadership, translate complex technical topics into business impact, and drive organizational consensus.
  • Strong Business Sense: Deep commercial intuition with the ability to connect algorithmic performance (relevance, precision, candidate conversion) directly to platform health and client retention.
  • Two-Sided Marketplace Expertise: Proven track record of balancing dual stakeholder needs—solving for both B2C consumer discovery and B2B enterprise/recruiter search workflows.
  • Strategic & Resource Allocation Mastery: Experience shaping functional product strategies, managing engineering trade-offs, and maximizing investment ROI without direct P&L management.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Skilled at building trust and alignment across matrixed organizations, including Data Science, Machine Learning, UX, and Commercial teams.
  • People Management Experience: Demonstrated success coaching, mentoring, and leading product managers to drive team growth and operational excellence.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical, quantitative, or business field (or equivalent practical experience).

What's good to have

  • Direct experience presenting strategic roadmaps and performance insights to C-suite executives and board members.
  • Background in recruitment technology, two-sided talent marketplaces, resume indexing systems, or professional networking platforms.
  • Familiarity with modern AI/ML search paradigms, Large Language Models (LLMs) for semantic matching, or vector search technologies.
  • Experience scaling product rituals and decision frameworks within high-growth software organizations.

Additional Pay Ranges

  • All other locations: $170,000-$200,000
  • SF/NY/Seattle : $190,000-$240,000
  • IL/TX: $180,000-$220,000

Outstanding Compensation

  • Bi-annual bonus
  • 401(k) plan with match
  • Equity in company
  • Flexible spending accounts (health, dependent care)
  • Internet and home office reimbursement

100% Full Health Benefits

  • Wellness reimbursement (gym, health apps, etc.)
  • Pet Insurance (optional)

Flexible Time Away

  • Flexible PTO
  • Sick time policy
  • Observed holidays

Eligible Hiring Locations

This position is 100% remote, work from home.

BOLD can hire full-time residents of the following U.S. States & Territories: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia (Washington D.C) Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

Join Us at TailorMed – Transforming Healthcare Affordability

Awarded Best in Class in Health Equity 2025

At TailorMed, we’re on a mission to eliminate barriers across the entire medication journey—from affordability to access and adherence. As a pioneering force in healthcare, we’re building a new category that transforms how patients, providers, pharmacies, life sciences, and payers collaborate to ensure every patient receives the treatment they need without delay.

TailorMed is the medication success platform removing every barrier across the patient journey, from access and affordability through adherence and ongoing care. TailorMed's platform connects patients, providers, pharmacies, and life sciences companies through one coordinated network designed to reach every patient at every step of their medication journey.

About the Role:

The Customer Success Manager serves as an advocate and the primary point of contact for a portfolio of accounts, ensuring customers are fully engaged and deriving maximum value from our solutions. In this role, you’ll guide clients through the entire customer journey—from onboarding to ongoing support to renewal—not only providing exceptional service, but identifying opportunities to expand and provide even greater ROI for our clients.

As the day-to-day contact for your accounts, you will build strong relationships and ensure that each customer is receiving maximum value from our solution. Additionally, you’ll collaborate closely with our Product and R&D teams, acting as the voice of the customer to provide feedback and drive continuous improvement.

raw.excerpt: NVIDIA DGX Cloud is the AI supercomputing-as-a-service substrate designed to power the next generation of AI and industrial-scale breakthroughs.
raw.description:
NVIDIA DGX Cloud is the AI supercomputing-as-a-service substrate designed to power the next generation of AI and industrial-scale breakthroughs. As a Security Engineer within our Infrastructure Security Engineering organization, you will not just help "secure" our platform—you will architect and build the foundational security primitives that protect massive-scale GPU clusters. You will design automated, resilient security systems that help ensure the integrity of our omni-cloud and on-premise AI infrastructure.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Security Engineering: Design, build, and integrate production-grade security services. You will focus on the engineering of security products—transforming third-party and open-source tools into seamless, API-driven components of the DGX Cloud security stack.

  • Automated Policy Enforcement: Shift security "left" by developing Infrastructure as Code and Policy as Code to automate security enforcement and compliance at the speed of cloud-scale deployment.

  • Orchestration Security & Guardrails: Architect and implement the security control plane. You will engineer automated guardrails, controllers, and runtime security policies that validate and enforce the integrity of tenant boundaries.

  • Security-as-a-Service Approach: Designing and operating security services as a scalable platform. Building "self-service" security primitives (e.g., Identity-as-a-Service, automated secrets management, and real-time scanning APIs) that allow developer teams to move fast.

  • Security Tooling & Lifecycle: Develop internal security frameworks and automated response systems. Responsible for the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) of the security tools, including testing, deployment, and maintenance.

  • Threat Modeling & System Design: Conduct deep-dive threat models on complex distributed systems and the DGX Cloud stack, identifying architectural gaps in security and engineering the solutions to close them.

  • Multi-Functional Collaboration: Partner with DGX Cloud platform teams, broader NVIDIA security teams, and product engineering to understand their needs and build paved paths that seamlessly embed security into the CI/CD pipeline and the hardware lifecycle.

What We Need to See:

We are looking for high-caliber engineers with deep spikes of expertise in a few of these areas and the intellectual curiosity to dive into the rest. If your experience aligns with the core of this role—building resilient security systems—and you can show us how, we want to hear from you!

  • Infrastructure Engineering: Experience (typically 8+ years) in SRE, Software Engineering, and Infrastructure Security. You focus on building systemic solutions rather than performing manual operations or "tool administration."

  • Production-Grade Coding: A strong software engineering background with the ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. You should be comfortable building and maintaining production service at scale.

  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Understanding of cloud-native architecture, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and the security challenges inherent in high-throughput, low-latency environments.

  • Platformizing Security: Transform complex security requirements into consumable internal services. You will focus on the "Developer Experience" of security, ensuring that our infrastructure security controls are delivered as robust, API-first platforms that integrate seamlessly with NVIDIA’s internal engineering workflows.

  • Security Product Integration: Proven track record of taking complex security products (AuthN/AuthZ, Vaulting, Scanning, IDS) and integrating them into an automated infrastructure via APIs and custom glue-code.

  • Linux Internals: Strong hands-on experience with Linux systems security, including kernel-level primitives (eBPF, AppArmor, or SELinux).

  • Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

Ways To Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • HPC/AI Security: Experience securing high-performance computing environments, RDMA-based networks, or GPU-specific security challenges.

  • Cloud-Native Identity: Expertise in workload identity frameworks (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE) and hardware-root-of-trust (TPM/HSM) integration.

  • Open Source Impact: Notable contributions to security-focused open-source projects or a track record of engineering-focused security research. How have you represented and helped advance the industry?

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
170,000 CAD – 220,000 CAD for Level 4; and 225,000 CAD – 275,000 CAD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Job Summary The Senior Electrical Engineer is responsible for leading portions of multi-discipline design projects related to power distribution, substation design, renewable energy systems, and mission-critical facilities such as data centers. This role includes performing engineering analyses, developing designs, PE-sealing construction documents, supporting construction, and mentoring junior staff while working under general supervision of project managers. ** OPEN TO REMOTE CANDIDATES ** Responsibilities Produce preliminary and final design drawings using computer aided drafting systems for: Power distribution systems – commercial, industrial, etc. Substations, switchgear Data center electrical infrastructure Renewable energy collection systems Perform engineering calculations such as: Load flow, short circuit, coordination, and voltage drop Equipment sizing and conductor selection Grounding, underground thermal ampacity, and cable pulling Apply and interpret applicable codes and standards (NEC, NESC, IEEE, ANSI, utility standards). Lead portions of project design efforts, coordinating with civil, structural, and mechanical disciplines. Ensure project engineering activities comply with company and contract requirements and support overall construction schedule. Perform field surveys and prepare accurate field sketches; record verifications, prepare documentation and construction prints. Issue PE-sealed drawings and reports and provide technical support for construction, including participation in construction planning, execution, quality control, and completion of the work. Maintain project records for assigned work, package records per contract requirements and facilitate turnover to the client’s representative. Responsible for ongoing communication and timely identification of issues and pending or actual changes to the work performed that may impact costs, schedule, contract or customer relationship. Review RFP’s, prepare fee estimates and proposals. Additional duties as assigned. Qualifications Preferred Qualifications Experience with substation design (e.g., one-line diagrams, protection schemes, grounding systems) Experience with data center design (tiered/redundant systems, backup generation, UPS systems) Experience reviewing construction drawings and supporting commissioning activities Physical Demands and Work Environment This job operates in both a professional office environment and field settings (including substations and active construction/data center sites). Standard office equipment is routinely used. The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform essential functions. This role is primarily sedentary but includes fieldwork requiring walking, climbing, and occasional lifting (up to 50 pounds). raw.description:
About us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.


What you'll do

The Global Payroll Operations Partner is responsible for the successful operational delivery, validation and oversight of assigned payrolls and legal entities. Acting as the primary operational owner for a portfolio of payrolls, countries and entities, this role ensures payrolls are delivered accurately, compliantly and on time through effective payroll validation, issue resolution, stakeholder management and vendor management.

The Payroll Operations Partner works closely with HR Service Delivery, Finance, Reward, Benefits, Technology teams and external payroll providers to deliver a seamless payroll experience while maintaining strong controls, compliance and operational excellence.

As the payroll function continues to evolve, this role will increasingly leverage data, automation, artificial intelligence and emerging technologies to improve payroll outcomes, enhance employee experience and generate business insights.

This role reports to the Payroll Manager.


The day-to-day

Payroll Portfolio Ownership

  • Act as the operational owner for assigned payrolls, countries and legal entities.
  • Maintain accountability for payroll delivery and operational outcomes within assigned payroll portfolios.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and payroll providers.
  • Manage payroll-related risks, dependencies and operational issues.
  • Escalate significant risks or service issues appropriately.

Data Quality & Exception Management

  • Investigate payroll-impacting data issues and discrepancies.
  • Monitor integration exceptions and payroll-related data issues.
  • Partner with HR Service Delivery and other stakeholders to resolve root causes.
  • Identify recurring data quality concerns and support long-term resolution.

Vendor & Service Management

  • Act as the primary operational contact for payroll providers supporting assigned payrolls.
  • Monitor service quality and responsiveness.
  • Support operational vendor reviews and improvement discussions.
  • Escalate service delivery concerns through established governance channels.
  • Build effective working relationships with payroll vendors and service partners.

Employee & Stakeholder Support

  • Provide payroll expertise and support to employees, managers and internal stakeholders.
  • Resolve complex payroll enquiries and escalations through ServiceNow and other channels.
  • Deliver a responsive and employee-focused service experience.
  • Act as a trusted payroll partner for assigned payroll portfolios.

Compliance & Controls

  • Execute payroll controls in accordance with the Global Payroll Governance Framework.
  • Complete reconciliations, validations and payroll approval activities.
  • Support audit requests, compliance reviews and governance activities.
  • Ensure payroll procedures are followed consistently.
  • Escalate compliance concerns, control failures and operational risks.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Maintain country and payroll-specific procedures.
  • Ensure payroll documentation remains accurate and up to date.
  • Support annual reviews of payroll processes and controls.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing and cross-training activities.

Continuous Improvement, Data & Innovation

  • Identify opportunities to improve payroll quality, efficiency and employee experience.
  • Use payroll data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
  • Support automation, process simplification and standardisation initiatives.
  • Contribute ideas that increase the value of payroll data and insights.
  • Support the adoption of emerging technologies, including AI and automation solutions.

What you'll need

  • 3+ years payroll experience within a complex payroll environment.
  • Experience working with outsourced payroll providers.
  • Strong understanding of payroll validation, controls and reconciliations.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and investigative skills.
  • Experience managing payroll issues, exceptions and escalations.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience using HRIS and payroll technology platforms.
  • Strong Excel and data analysis capability.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality and accuracy.
  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions, entities or payroll providers.

What will help you on the job

  • Experience working within a multinational organisation.
  • Experience with Workday.
  • Payroll qualification (CPP, CIPP or equivalent).
  • Experience supporting payroll transformation initiatives.
  • Experience working with payroll integrations and automation solutions.
  • Ability to interpret payroll data and identify business insights and trends.
  • Knowledge of AI-enabled, analytics-driven or technology-led payroll operating models.

EEO Statement

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. If you would like to request an accommodation on the basis of disability for completing this on-line application, please click here.

Climate Collective Foundation is a not-for-profit organization dedicated to supporting climate tech startups. We work within the climate ecosystem to foster innovation by connecting startups with funding, investors, education, and accelerator programs. Our remote team of above 60 members operates collaboratively to drive impactful, sustainable solutions for climate-related challenges.

About the Role
We are looking for a creative Graphic Designer with 5–6 years of experience to develop and maintain strong, consistent brand identities across our online and offline events. The role involves creating engaging visual assets across print, digital, and event-specific platforms, building design systems, and ensuring brand consistency. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate ideas into compelling visual communication.
​

Key Responsibilities

·Create and refine event branding materials, including logos, promotional posters, digital assets, and event print materials

·Develop designs across multiple formats such as social media, brochures, flex banners, hanging flexes, stationery materials, booklets, and print announcements

·Collaborate closely with project managers, event coordinators, and the broader team to ensure deliverables align with project goals.

·Quickly grasp design briefs and efficiently translate them into high-quality visual assets.

Requirements

  • 5–6 years of professional experience in graphic/creative design.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating print and digital design work, particularly event-related branding.

  • Experience or a strong interest in the climate tech sector will be an added advantage.

Skills Required

  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, and After Effects.

  • Familiarity with additional design tools such as Canva, Figma, and CorelDRAW.

  • Excellent English communication skills for clear and effective collaboration within the team.

  • Ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines while maintaining high-quality design standards.

  • Comfortable handling multiple review rounds, quick turnarounds, and last-minute changes.

  • A proactive team player with the ability to understand creative requirements, collaborate effectively, and adapt to feedback.

Location

Remote. The position is entirely remote, and candidates from any location in India are encouraged to apply.

Covering 40% of all U.S. transactions and active in 45 countries, Appriss Retail is trusted by 60+ of the top 100 U.S. retailers to deliver lasting performance improvement. Learn more at apprissretail.com.

Overview

This next-generation SDR role owns outbound campaigns aimed at senior retail leaders and books qualified meetings with executive buyers, using AI and signal-driven, account-based strategies. You’ll work closely with Growth Marketing and Sales to personalize outreach at scale and continuously optimize your approach. The ideal candidate is curious, tenacious, and eager to grow as a key contributor to pipeline success.

Essential Duties

  • AI-Outbound Campaign Ownership –Builds, launches, and updates outbound campaigns end to end by persona, competitor, industry, event, and market trend. Uses AI-based tools, signals from the signal agent, sequence performance, and market research to decide what to change, reach the right executives at the right time with specific, relevant messaging, and generate qualified meetings with executive buyers.

  • Enterprise B2B SaaS experience.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite or similar software.
  • Proficient in Claude Cowork.
